# Search input limits
MAX_QUESTION_CHARS <- 500
MAX_KEYWORD_CHARS <- 250

`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) y else x
}

clean_names <- function(x) {
  x |>
    stringr::str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_") |>
    stringr::str_replace_all("_+$", "") |>
    stringr::str_replace_all("^_+", "") |>
    tolower()
}

as_text <- function(x) {
  x <- ifelse(is.na(x), "", as.character(x))
  stringr::str_squish(x)
}

split_terms <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) return(character())
  x <- paste(x, collapse = " ")
  terms <- stringr::str_split(tolower(x), "[,;\\n\\r]+|\\s+and\\s+|\\s+or\\s+")[[1]]
  terms <- stringr::str_squish(terms)
  terms <- terms[nchar(terms) >= 3]
  unique(terms)
}

# --- Search normalization + synonym expansion -------------------------------

normalize_text <- function(x) {
  x <- ifelse(is.na(x), "", as.character(x))
  x <- tolower(x)
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "\\bcovid[- ]?19\\b", "covid19")
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "\\bsars[- ]?cov[- ]?2\\b", "sarscov2")
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "[’`]", "'")
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "[-_/]", " ")
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "[^a-z0-9\\s]", " ")
  stringr::str_squish(x)
}

light_stem <- function(word) {
  w <- tolower(as.character(word))
  if (nchar(w) <= 3) return(w)

  if (grepl("ies$", w)) {
    return(sub("ies$", "y", w))
  }

  if (grepl("(sses|xes|zes|ches|shes)$", w)) {
    return(sub("es$", "", w))
  }

  if (grepl("ing$", w) && nchar(w) > 5) {
    return(sub("ing$", "", w))
  }

  if (grepl("ed$", w) && nchar(w) > 4) {
    return(sub("ed$", "", w))
  }

  if (grepl("s$", w) && !grepl("(ss|us|is|os|as|es)$", w) && nchar(w) > 4) {
    return(sub("s$", "", w))
  }

  w
}

normalize_search_term <- function(term) {
  term <- normalize_text(term)
  if (!nzchar(term)) return("")

  tokens <- stringr::str_split(term, "\\s+")[[1]]
  tokens <- tokens[nchar(tokens) > 0]
  tokens <- vapply(tokens, light_stem, character(1))
  tokens <- tokens[nchar(tokens) > 0]

  paste(tokens, collapse = " ")
}

normalize_search_terms <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) return(character())
  vapply(x, normalize_search_term, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

parse_search_terms <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) return(character())

  raw <- paste(x, collapse = " ")

  quoted <- stringr::str_match_all(raw, '"([^"]+)"')[[1]]
  quoted_terms <- if (nrow(quoted) > 0) quoted[, 2] else character()

  stripped <- stringr::str_replace_all(raw, '"[^"]+"', " ")
  pieces <- stringr::str_split(stripped, "[,;\\n\\r]+|\\s+and\\s+|\\s+or\\s+|\\s+")[[1]]

  terms <- c(quoted_terms, pieces)
  terms <- stringr::str_squish(terms)
  terms <- terms[nchar(terms) >= 2]
  unique(terms)
}

build_synonym_index <- function(dict) {
  index <- list()

  for (group_name in names(dict)) {
    group_terms <- unique(c(group_name, dict[[group_name]]))
    group_terms <- unique(vapply(group_terms, normalize_search_term, character(1)))
    group_terms <- group_terms[nzchar(group_terms)]

    for (term in group_terms) {
      index[[term]] <- unique(c(index[[term]], group_terms))
    }
  }

  index
}

synonym_index <- build_synonym_index(search_lexicon)

extract_words <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) return(character())

  stop_words <- c(
    "the", "and", "for", "with", "from", "this", "that",
    "what", "which", "how", "does", "do", "is", "are",
    "between", "among", "association", "relationship", "relation",
    "data", "source", "sources", "study", "research",
    "using", "use", "want", "need", "look", "about",
    "of", "a", "an",
    "interest", "interested",
    "outcome", "outcomes"
  )

  words <- stringr::str_split(
    tolower(paste(x, collapse = " ")),
    "[^a-z0-9]+"
  )[[1]]

  words <- words[nchar(words) >= 3]

  unique(words[!words %in% stop_words])
}

expand_terms <- function(terms) {
  if (is.null(terms) || length(terms) == 0) return(character())

  # Normalize input terms
  normalized <- unique(vapply(terms, normalize_search_term, character(1)))
  normalized <- normalized[nzchar(normalized)]

  expanded <- normalized

  # 1) Expand using the synonym index built from search_lexicon
  for (term in normalized) {
    if (!is.null(synonym_index[[term]])) {
      expanded <- c(expanded, synonym_index[[term]])
    }
  }

  # 2) Expand using the concept_dictionary
  concept_terms <- unlist(
    concept_dictionary[intersect(names(concept_dictionary), normalized)],
    use.names = FALSE
  )

  if (length(concept_terms) > 0) {
    expanded <- c(expanded, normalize_search_terms(concept_terms))
  }

  unique(expanded[nzchar(expanded)])
}


contains_any <- function(text, terms) {
  if (length(terms) == 0) return(rep(FALSE, length(text)))
  purrr::map_lgl(text, function(txt) {
    any(stringr::str_detect(txt, stringr::fixed(terms, ignore_case = TRUE)))
  })
}

safe_col <- function(df, nm, default = "") {
  if (nm %in% names(df)) as_text(df[[nm]]) else rep(default, nrow(df))
}

standardize_access_burden <- function(access_level, access_burden) {
  existing <- as_text(access_burden)
  access <- tolower(as_text(access_level))
  inferred <- dplyr::case_when(
    stringr::str_detect(access, "open/public") & !stringr::str_detect(access, "restricted|controlled|credentialed|purchased") ~ "Low",
    stringr::str_detect(access, "registered public-use|public-use plus restricted|registered/controlled|open plus credentialed|open plus controlled|terms") ~ "Medium",
    stringr::str_detect(access, "controlled|restricted|credentialed|purchased") ~ "High",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown"
  )
  ifelse(nchar(existing) > 0, existing, inferred)
}

infer_data_type <- function(text) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    stringr::str_detect(text, "survey|surveys|questionnaire|household|behavioral risk") ~ "Survey",
    stringr::str_detect(text, "registry|surveillance|incidence|mortality|prevalence|vital statistics") ~ "Registry/surveillance",
    stringr::str_detect(text, "claims|medicare|medicaid|payment|cost|expenditure|insurance|provider|enrollment") ~ "Claims/payment",
    stringr::str_detect(text, "ehr|electronic health record|clinical|hospital|icu|encounter|diagnosis|laboratory|medication") ~ "EHR/clinical",
    stringr::str_detect(text, "cohort|longitudinal|follow-up|retirement|aging") ~ "Cohort/longitudinal",
    stringr::str_detect(text, "county|tract|zip|zcta|geographic|geospatial|census|vulnerability|rural") ~ "Geospatial/area-level",
    stringr::str_detect(text, "environment|air quality|water|hazardous|toxic|exposure|heat") ~ "Environmental",
    stringr::str_detect(text, "genom|genotype|phenotype|gene expression|molecular|transcriptomics|biospecimen") ~ "Genomics/molecular",
    stringr::str_detect(text, "imaging|radiology|pathology|mri|ct|dicom") ~ "Imaging",
    stringr::str_detect(text, "physiologic|ecg|waveform") ~ "Physiologic signals",
    stringr::str_detect(text, "clinical trial|trial registry|intervention|sponsor") ~ "Trial registry",
    stringr::str_detect(text, "synthetic") ~ "Synthetic data",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

standardize_access_level <- function(access_level_standardized, raw_access_level) {
  existing <- as_text(access_level_standardized)
  raw <- as_text(raw_access_level)

  # Keep an existing standardized value when one is provided
  candidate <- ifelse(nchar(existing) > 0, existing, raw)
  access <- tolower(candidate)

  dplyr::case_when(
    access == "open/public" ~ "Open/public",
    access == "registered public-use" ~ "Registered public-use",
    access == "registered/controlled" ~ "Registered/controlled",
    access == "credentialed access" ~ "Credentialed access",
    access == "controlled/restricted" ~ "Controlled/restricted",
    access == "public-use plus restricted files" ~ "Public-use plus restricted files",
    access == "open plus controlled data" ~ "Open plus controlled data",
    access == "open plus credentialed access" ~ "Open plus credentialed access",
    access == "open/public with terms" ~ "Open/public with terms",

    # Mixed public + restricted access
    stringr::str_detect(access, "registered") &
      stringr::str_detect(access, "controlled|restricted") ~
      "Registered/controlled",

    stringr::str_detect(access, "open|public") &
      stringr::str_detect(access, "credentialed") ~
      "Open plus credentialed access",

    stringr::str_detect(access, "open|public") &
      stringr::str_detect(access, "controlled|restricted|purchased") ~
      "Open plus controlled data",

    # Single access types
    stringr::str_detect(access, "registered") ~
      "Registered public-use",

    stringr::str_detect(access, "credentialed") ~
      "Credentialed access",

    stringr::str_detect(access, "controlled|restricted|purchased") ~
      "Controlled/restricted",

    stringr::str_detect(access, "terms of use") ~
      "Open/public with terms",

    # General public/free-access descriptions
    stringr::str_detect(
      access,
      "open|public|free data|free download|no account|without authentication"
    ) ~ "Open/public",

    TRUE ~ "Unknown"
  )
}

prepare_catalog <- function(df) {
  df <- df |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      access_level_standardized = standardize_access_level(
  access_level_standardized,
  raw_access_level
),
      search_text = tolower(paste(
        data_source,
        official_link_text,
        main_data_type_use,
        raw_access_level,
        access_level_standardized,
        primary_category,
        secondary_categories_tags,
        keywords_for_search,
        data_type_standardized,
        topic_area_s,
        population,
        geography_coverage,
        geographic_unit,
        unit_of_analysis,
        common_variables_measures,
        suggested_use_cases,
        companion_datasets,
        limitations_cautions,
        data_governance_notes,
        rdcd_consultation_notes,
        app_search_text,
        sep = " "
      )),
      concept_text = tolower(paste(
        primary_category,
        secondary_categories_tags,
        keywords_for_search,
        common_variables_measures,
        suggested_use_cases,
        companion_datasets,
        limitations_cautions,
        rdcd_consultation_notes,
        sep = " "
      )),

      # Normalized text for forgiving search
    search_text_normalized = normalize_text(search_text),
    concept_text_normalized = normalize_text(concept_text),

    data_source_norm = normalize_search_terms(data_source),
    keywords_for_search_norm = normalize_search_terms(keywords_for_search),
    primary_category_norm = normalize_search_terms(primary_category),
    secondary_categories_tags_norm = normalize_search_terms(secondary_categories_tags),
    suggested_use_cases_norm = normalize_search_terms(suggested_use_cases),
    main_data_type_use_norm = normalize_search_terms(main_data_type_use),
    limitations_cautions_norm = normalize_search_terms(limitations_cautions),
    rdcd_consultation_notes_norm = normalize_search_terms(rdcd_consultation_notes),

    geography_search = normalize_text(
  paste(
    geography_coverage,
    geographic_unit,
    sep = " "
  )
),

data_type_search = normalize_text(
  paste(
    data_type_standardized,
    main_data_type_use,
    sep = " "
  )
),

population_norm = normalize_text(
  population
),

common_variables_measures_norm = normalize_text(
  common_variables_measures
),


      category_for_filter = dplyr::if_else(
        nchar(primary_category) > 0,
        primary_category,
        ""
      ),
      data_type_for_filter = dplyr::if_else(
        nchar(data_type_standardized) > 0,
        data_type_standardized,
        infer_data_type(search_text)
      ),
      access_burden_for_filter = standardize_access_burden(access_level_standardized, access_burden),
      official_url = dplyr::if_else(nchar(official_url) > 0, official_url, NA_character_)
    )

  df
}

score_terms_against_catalog <- function(df, terms) {

  if (length(terms) == 0 || nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(rep(0, nrow(df)))
  }

  term_scores <- lapply(terms, function(term) {

    term <- normalize_search_term(term)

    if (!nzchar(term)) {
      return(rep(0, nrow(df)))
    }

    primary_match <- stringr::str_detect(
      df$primary_category_norm,
      stringr::fixed(term, ignore_case = TRUE)
    )

    keyword_match <- stringr::str_detect(
      df$keywords_for_search_norm,
      stringr::fixed(term, ignore_case = TRUE)
    )

    secondary_match <- stringr::str_detect(
      df$secondary_categories_tags_norm,
      stringr::fixed(term, ignore_case = TRUE)
    )

    variable_match <- stringr::str_detect(
      df$common_variables_measures_norm,
      stringr::fixed(term, ignore_case = TRUE)
    )

    use_case_match <- stringr::str_detect(
      df$suggested_use_cases_norm,
      stringr::fixed(term, ignore_case = TRUE)
    )

    population_match <- stringr::str_detect(
      df$population_norm,
      stringr::fixed(term, ignore_case = TRUE)
    )

    geography_match <- stringr::str_detect(
      df$geography_search,
      stringr::fixed(term, ignore_case = TRUE)
    )

    data_type_match <- stringr::str_detect(
      df$data_type_search,
      stringr::fixed(term, ignore_case = TRUE)
    )

    data_source_match <- stringr::str_detect(
      df$data_source_norm,
      stringr::fixed(term, ignore_case = TRUE)
    )

    general_match <- stringr::str_detect(
      df$search_text_normalized,
      stringr::fixed(term, ignore_case = TRUE)
    )

    pmax(
      ifelse(primary_match, 1.00, 0),
      ifelse(keyword_match, 0.90, 0),
      ifelse(variable_match, 0.88, 0),
      ifelse(secondary_match, 0.80, 0),
      ifelse(population_match, 0.80, 0),
      ifelse(geography_match, 0.80, 0),
      ifelse(data_type_match, 0.75, 0),
      ifelse(use_case_match, 0.60, 0),
      ifelse(data_source_match, 0.50, 0),
      ifelse(general_match, 0.20, 0)
    )
  })

  matrix_scores <- do.call(cbind, term_scores)

  rowMeans(matrix_scores)
}


score_catalog <- function(
  df,
  original_terms,
  expanded_terms,
  category_filter,
  data_type_filter,
  geography_filter,
  access_filter,
  open_only
) {

  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(df)
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Normalize and clean terms once
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  original_terms <- unique(
    vapply(
      original_terms[nzchar(original_terms)],
      normalize_search_term,
      character(1),
      USE.NAMES = FALSE
    )
  )

  original_terms <- original_terms[nzchar(original_terms)]

  expanded_terms <- unique(
    vapply(
      expanded_terms[nzchar(expanded_terms)],
      normalize_search_term,
      character(1),
      USE.NAMES = FALSE
    )
  )

  expanded_terms <- expanded_terms[nzchar(expanded_terms)]

  expanded_terms <- setdiff(
    expanded_terms,
    original_terms
  )

  source_terms <- unique(
    c(original_terms, expanded_terms)
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cheap filters FIRST
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  if (length(category_filter) > 0) {
    df <- df |>
      dplyr::filter(
        category_for_filter %in% category_filter
      )
  }

  if (length(data_type_filter) > 0) {
    df <- df |>
      dplyr::filter(
        data_type_for_filter %in% data_type_filter
      )
  }

  if (length(geography_filter) > 0) {

    geography_terms <- normalize_text(
      geography_filter
    )

    geography_text <- normalize_text(
      paste(
        df$geography_coverage,
        df$geographic_unit,
        sep = " "
      )
    )

    df <- df[
      contains_any(
        geography_text,
        geography_terms
      ),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  }

  if (length(access_filter) > 0) {
    df <- df |>
      dplyr::filter(
        contains_any(
          access_level_standardized,
          access_filter
        )
      )
  }

  if (isTRUE(open_only)) {
    df <- df |>
      dplyr::filter(
        access_burden_for_filter == "Low" |
          stringr::str_detect(
            tolower(access_level_standardized),
            "open|public"
          )
      )
  }

  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(df)
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Candidate filtering BEFORE expensive scoring
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  if (length(source_terms) > 0) {

    candidate_mask <- contains_any(
      df$search_text_normalized,
      source_terms
    )

    df <- df[
      candidate_mask,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  }

  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(df)
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Score original terms
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  original_score <- score_terms_against_catalog(
    df,
    original_terms
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Score expanded terms
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  expanded_score <- score_terms_against_catalog(
    df,
    expanded_terms
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Final relevance score
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  match_score <- if (length(expanded_terms) > 0) {
    (original_score * 85) +
      (expanded_score * 15)
  } else {
    original_score * 100
  }

  match_score <- round(
    pmax(
      0,
      pmin(
        100,
        match_score
      )
    ),
    1
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Keyword-hit diagnostic
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  keyword_hits_vec <- purrr::map_int(
    df$search_text_normalized,
    function(txt) {

      sum(
        vapply(
          original_terms,
          function(term) {
            stringr::str_detect(
              txt,
              stringr::fixed(
                term,
                ignore_case = TRUE
              )
            )
          },
          logical(1)
        )
      )
    }
  )
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
# Original-term coverage diagnostic
# ------------------------------------------------------------

matched_original_terms_text <- purrr::map_chr(
  df$search_text_normalized,
  function(txt) {

    hits <- original_terms[
      vapply(
        original_terms,
        function(term) {
          stringr::str_detect(
            txt,
            stringr::fixed(
              term,
              ignore_case = TRUE
            )
          )
        },
        logical(1)
      )
    ]

    paste(
      unique(hits),
      collapse = "; "
    )
  }
)

missing_original_terms_text <- purrr::map_chr(
  df$search_text_normalized,
  function(txt) {

    misses <- original_terms[
      !vapply(
        original_terms,
        function(term) {
          stringr::str_detect(
            txt,
            stringr::fixed(
              term,
              ignore_case = TRUE
            )
          )
        },
        logical(1)
      )
    ]

    paste(
      unique(misses),
      collapse = "; "
    )
  }
)

original_terms_matched_n <- purrr::map_int(
  df$search_text_normalized,
  function(txt) {

    sum(
      vapply(
        original_terms,
        function(term) {
          stringr::str_detect(
            txt,
            stringr::fixed(
              term,
              ignore_case = TRUE
            )
          )
        },
        logical(1)
      )
    )
  }
)

original_terms_total_n <- length(original_terms)

original_term_coverage <- if (original_terms_total_n > 0) {
  round(
    (original_terms_matched_n / original_terms_total_n) * 100,
    1
  )
} else {
  0
}

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Matched-term display
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  matched_terms_text <- purrr::map_chr(
    df$search_text_normalized,
    function(txt) {

      hits <- source_terms[
        vapply(
          source_terms,
          function(term) {
            stringr::str_detect(
              txt,
              stringr::fixed(
                term,
                ignore_case = TRUE
              )
            )
          },
          logical(1)
        )
      ]

      paste(
        head(
          unique(hits),
          12
        ),
        collapse = "; "
      )
    }
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Build output
  #
  # IMPORTANT:
  # original_exact_score used to repeat the expensive
  # original-term scoring. It was mathematically identical
  # to original_score, so reuse original_score.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  original_exact_score <- original_score

  out <- df |>
    dplyr::mutate(

      original_match_score =
        round(original_score * 100, 1),

      expanded_match_score =
        round(expanded_score * 100, 1),

      exact_match_strength =
        round(original_exact_score * 100, 1),

      keyword_hits =
  keyword_hits_vec,

matched_terms =
  matched_terms_text,

matched_original_terms =
  matched_original_terms_text,

missing_original_terms =
  missing_original_terms_text,

original_terms_matched_n =
  original_terms_matched_n,

original_terms_total_n =
  original_terms_total_n,

original_term_coverage =
  original_term_coverage,

match_score =
  match_score,

      concept_score =
        round(original_score * 100, 1),

      concept_hit =
        original_score > 0,

      why_matched = paste0(
        "Original-term relevance: ",
        round(original_score * 100),
        "%. ",

        "Expanded-term support: ",
        round(expanded_score * 100),
        "%. ",

        "Strongest structured evidence: ",
        round(original_exact_score * 100),
        "%."
      )
    )

  out |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(match_score),
      dplyr::desc(exact_match_strength),
      dplyr::desc(keyword_hits),
      data_source
    )
}


make_html_link <- function(label, url) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(url) | nchar(url) == 0,
    label,
    sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">%s</a>', url, label)
  )
}

make_score_badge <- function(score) {
  purrr::map_chr(score, function(x) {
    if (is.na(x)) {
      return(
        '<span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.2;white-space:nowrap;background:#F3F4F6;color:#4B5563;">N/A</span>'
      )
    }

    if (x >= 70) {
      bg <- "#DCFCE7"; fg <- "#166534"
    } else if (x >= 40) {
      bg <- "#FEF3C7"; fg <- "#92400E"
    } else {
      bg <- "#FEE2E2"; fg <- "#991B1B"
    }

    sprintf(
      '<span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.2;white-space:nowrap;background:%s;color:%s;">%s%%</span>',
      bg, fg, round(x)
    )
  })
}

make_access_badge <- function(access) {
  purrr::map_chr(access, function(x) {
    access_lower <- tolower(as_text(x))

    if (stringr::str_detect(access_lower, "restricted")) {
      bg <- "#FEE2E2"; fg <- "#991B1B"; label <- "Restricted"
    } else if (stringr::str_detect(access_lower, "controlled|credentialed")) {
      bg <- "#FEF3C7"; fg <- "#92400E"; label <- "Controlled"
    } else if (stringr::str_detect(access_lower, "registered")) {
      bg <- "#E0F2FE"; fg <- "#075985"; label <- "Registered"
    } else if (stringr::str_detect(access_lower, "open|public")) {
      bg <- "#DCFCE7"; fg <- "#166534"; label <- "Open"
    } else {
      bg <- "#F3F4F6"; fg <- "#4B5563"; label <- ifelse(nzchar(x), x, "Unknown")
    }

    sprintf(
      '<span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.2;white-space:nowrap;background:%s;color:%s;">%s</span>',
      bg, fg, htmltools::htmlEscape(label)
    )
  })
}

# ============================================================
# Word report helpers
# ============================================================

make_report_score_label <- function(score) {

  score <- as.numeric(score)

  if (is.na(score)) {
    return("N/A")
  }

  paste0(round(score), "% match")
}


make_report_access_label <- function(access) {

  access_lower <- tolower(as_text(access))

  if (stringr::str_detect(access_lower, "restricted")) {
    return("Restricted")
  }

  if (stringr::str_detect(access_lower, "controlled|credentialed")) {
    return("Controlled")
  }

  if (stringr::str_detect(access_lower, "registered")) {
    return("Registered")
  }

  if (stringr::str_detect(access_lower, "open|public")) {
    return("Open")
  }

  if (nzchar(as_text(access))) {
    return(as_text(access))
  }

  "Unknown"
}


report_value <- function(x, fallback = "Not specified") {

  x <- as_text(x)

  if (!nzchar(x)) {
    fallback
  } else {
    x
  }
}


make_report_tags <- function(row) {

  raw_tags <- c(
    split_terms(row$primary_category),
    split_terms(row$secondary_categories_tags),
    split_terms(row$data_type_for_filter),
    split_terms(row$geography_coverage)
  )

  tags_vec <- unique(
    raw_tags[nchar(raw_tags) > 0]
  )

  tags_vec <- head(tags_vec, 8)

  if (length(tags_vec) == 0) {
    return("None specified")
  }

  paste(tags_vec, collapse = "  |  ")
}

# ============================================================
# Word report styling helpers
# ============================================================

add_report_title <- function(doc, title, subtitle = NULL) {

  title_fp <- officer::fpar(
    officer::ftext(
      title,
      prop = officer::fp_text(
        bold = TRUE,
        color = "73000A",
        font.size = 22
      )
    ),
    fp_p = officer::fp_par(
      space_after = 6
    )
  )

  doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
    doc,
    title_fp
  )

  if (!is.null(subtitle) && nzchar(subtitle)) {

    subtitle_fp <- officer::fpar(
      officer::ftext(
        subtitle,
        prop = officer::fp_text(
          color = "6B7280",
          font.size = 12
        )
      ),
      fp_p = officer::fp_par(
        space_after = 4
      )
    )

    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      subtitle_fp
    )
  }

  doc
}


add_report_section_heading <- function(doc, text) {

  heading_fp <- officer::fpar(
    officer::ftext(
      text,
      prop = officer::fp_text(
        bold = TRUE,
        color = "73000A",
        font.size = 15
      )
    ),
    fp_p = officer::fp_par(
      space_before = 12,
      space_after = 6
    )
  )

  officer::body_add_fpar(
    doc,
    heading_fp
  )
}


add_report_subheading <- function(doc, text) {

  heading_fp <- officer::fpar(
    officer::ftext(
      text,
      prop = officer::fp_text(
        bold = TRUE,
        color = "1F2937",
        font.size = 11
      )
    ),
    fp_p = officer::fp_par(
      space_before = 8,
      space_after = 3
    )
  )

  officer::body_add_fpar(
    doc,
    heading_fp
  )
}


add_report_label_value <- function(
  doc,
  label,
  value,
  label_color = "5B0008"
) {

  value <- report_value(value)

  fp <- officer::fpar(
    officer::ftext(
      paste0(label, ": "),
      prop = officer::fp_text(
        bold = TRUE,
        color = label_color,
        font.size = 10
      )
    ),
    officer::ftext(
      value,
      prop = officer::fp_text(
        color = "374151",
        font.size = 10
      )
    ),
    fp_p = officer::fp_par(
      space_after = 3
    )
  )

  officer::body_add_fpar(
    doc,
    fp
  )
}


add_report_badge_line <- function(
  doc,
  score,
  access
) {

  score_text <- make_report_score_label(score)
  access_text <- make_report_access_label(access)

  fp <- officer::fpar(
    officer::ftext(
      score_text,
      prop = officer::fp_text(
        bold = TRUE,
        color = "166534",
        font.size = 10
      )
    ),
    officer::ftext(
      "   |   ",
      prop = officer::fp_text(
        color = "9CA3AF",
        font.size = 10
      )
    ),
    officer::ftext(
      access_text,
      prop = officer::fp_text(
        bold = TRUE,
        color = "73000A",
        font.size = 10
      )
    ),
    fp_p = officer::fp_par(
      space_after = 7
    )
  )

  officer::body_add_fpar(
    doc,
    fp
  )
}


add_report_hyperlink <- function(
  doc,
  text,
  url
) {

  url <- as_text(url)

  if (!nzchar(url)) {
    return(doc)
  }

  fp <- officer::fpar(
    officer::hyperlink_ftext(
      x = text,
      url = url,
      prop = officer::fp_text(
        color = "73000A",
        underline = TRUE,
        font.size = 10
      )
    ),
    fp_p = officer::fp_par(
      space_after = 8
    )
  )

  officer::body_add_fpar(
    doc,
    fp
  )
}


make_html_report <- function(df, question, keywords, min_score, top_n) {

  esc <- function(x, fallback = "Not specified") {
    x <- as_text(x)

    if (!nzchar(x)) {
      x <- fallback
    }

    htmltools::htmlEscape(x)
  }

  esc_attr <- function(x, fallback = "") {
    x <- as_text(x)

    if (!nzchar(x)) {
      x <- fallback
    }

    htmltools::htmlEscape(x, attribute = TRUE)
  }

  safe_url <- function(x) {
    x <- as_text(x)

    if (
      nzchar(x) &&
      stringr::str_detect(
        x,
        "^https?://"
      )
    ) {
      x
    } else {
      ""
    }
  }

  badge_class <- function(score) {
    score <- as.numeric(score)

    if (is.na(score)) {
      return("badge-neutral")
    }

    if (score >= 70) {
      "badge-good"
    } else if (score >= 40) {
      "badge-medium"
    } else {
      "badge-low"
    }
  }

  access_class <- function(access) {

    access <- tolower(as_text(access))

    if (stringr::str_detect(access, "restricted")) {
      return("access-restricted")
    }

    if (stringr::str_detect(access, "controlled|credentialed")) {
      return("access-controlled")
    }

    if (stringr::str_detect(access, "registered")) {
      return("access-registered")
    }

    if (stringr::str_detect(access, "open|public")) {
      return("access-open")
    }

    "access-other"
  }

  make_tags <- function(row) {

    tags <- c(
      split_terms(row$primary_category),
      split_terms(row$secondary_categories_tags),
      split_terms(row$data_type_for_filter),
      split_terms(row$geography_coverage)
    )

    tags <- unique(tags[nchar(tags) > 0])
    tags <- head(tags, 8)

    if (length(tags) == 0) {
      return('<span class="muted">None specified</span>')
    }

    paste0(
      '<span class="tag">',
      htmltools::htmlEscape(tags),
      '</span>',
      collapse = ""
    )
  }

  detail_item <- function(label, value) {
    paste0(
      '<div class="detail-item">',
        '<div class="detail-label">',
          htmltools::htmlEscape(label),
        '</div>',
        '<div class="detail-value">',
          esc(value),
        '</div>',
      '</div>'
    )
  }

  source_card <- function(row, rank_number) {

    score <- as.numeric(row$match_score)

    score_text <- if (is.na(score)) {
      "N/A"
    } else {
      paste0(round(score), "% match")
    }

    access_text <- make_report_access_label(
      row$access_level_standardized
    )

    official_url <- safe_url(row$official_url)

    source_link <- if (nzchar(official_url)) {
      paste0(
        '<a class="source-link" ',
        'href="', esc_attr(official_url), '" ',
        'target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">',
        'Open official source',
        '</a>'
      )
    } else {
      ""
    }

    summary_text <- as_text(row$main_data_type_use)

    if (!nzchar(summary_text)) {
      summary_text <- as_text(row$suggested_use_cases)
    }

    if (!nzchar(summary_text)) {
      summary_text <- "No summary is available for this source."
    }

    limitations <- as_text(row$limitations_cautions)

    limitations_html <- if (nzchar(limitations)) {
      paste0(
        '<div class="section-block">',
          '<div class="section-title">Limitations</div>',
          '<div class="body-text">',
            esc(limitations),
          '</div>',
        '</div>'
      )
    } else {
      ""
    }

    governance <- as_text(row$data_governance_notes)

    governance_html <- if (nzchar(governance)) {
      paste0(
        '<div class="section-block">',
          '<div class="section-title">Data Governance</div>',
          '<div class="body-text">',
            esc(governance),
          '</div>',
        '</div>'
      )
    } else {
      ""
    }

    use_cases <- as_text(row$suggested_use_cases)

    use_cases_html <- if (nzchar(use_cases)) {
      paste0(
        '<div class="section-block">',
          '<div class="section-title">Suggested Uses</div>',
          '<div class="body-text">',
            esc(use_cases),
          '</div>',
        '</div>'
      )
    } else {
      ""
    }

    companion <- as_text(row$companion_datasets)

    companion_html <- if (nzchar(companion)) {
      paste0(
        '<div class="section-block">',
          '<div class="section-title">Companion Datasets</div>',
          '<div class="body-text">',
            esc(companion),
          '</div>',
        '</div>'
      )
    } else {
      ""
    }

    paste0(
      '<article class="source-card">',

        '<div class="source-header">',

          '<div>',
            '<div class="source-rank">',
              'SOURCE ', rank_number,
            '</div>',

            '<h2 class="source-title">',
              esc(row$data_source),
            '</h2>',

            '<div class="tag-row">',
              make_tags(row),
            '</div>',
          '</div>',

          '<div class="source-badges">',

            '<span class="badge ',
              badge_class(score),
            '">',
              esc(score_text),
            '</span>',

            '<span class="badge ',
              access_class(row$access_level_standardized),
            '">',
              esc(access_text),
            '</span>',

          '</div>',

        '</div>',

        '<div class="summary-box">',
          '<div class="section-title">Summary</div>',
          '<div class="summary-text">',
            esc(summary_text),
          '</div>',
        '</div>',

               '<div class="section-block">',
          '<div class="section-title">Key Details</div>',

          '<div class="details-grid">',

            detail_item(
              "Category",
              row$category_for_filter
            ),

            detail_item(
              "Data Type",
              row$data_type_for_filter
            ),

            detail_item(
              "Population",
              row$population
            ),

            detail_item(
              "Geography",
              row$geography_coverage
            ),

            detail_item(
              "Unit of Analysis",
              row$unit_of_analysis
            ),

            detail_item(
              "Years Available",
              row$years_available
            ),

            detail_item(
              "Access Burden",
              row$access_burden_for_filter
            ),

            detail_item(
              "Linkage Potential",
              row$linkage_potential
            ),

            detail_item(
              "South Carolina Relevance",
              row$south_carolina_relevance
            ),

          '</div>',

        '</div>',
        '<div class="section-block">',
          '<div class="section-title">Why It Matched</div>',
          '<div class="callout">',
            esc(row$why_matched),
          '</div>',
        '</div>',

        use_cases_html,
        companion_html,
        limitations_html,
        governance_html,

        if (nzchar(source_link)) {
          paste0(
            '<div class="source-footer">',
              source_link,
            '</div>'
          )
        } else {
          ""
        },

      '</article>'
    )
  }

  total_matches <- nrow(df)

  highest_score <- if (total_matches > 0) {
    round(max(df$match_score, na.rm = TRUE))
  } else {
    0
  }

  average_score <- if (total_matches > 0) {
    round(mean(df$match_score, na.rm = TRUE))
  } else {
    0
  }

  open_public_count <- if (total_matches > 0) {
    sum(
      df$access_burden_for_filter == "Low" |
        stringr::str_detect(
          tolower(df$access_level_standardized),
          "open|public"
        ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    0
  }

  question <- esc(
    question,
    "No research question entered."
  )

  keywords <- esc(
    keywords,
    "None entered."
  )

  cards <- if (nrow(df) > 0) {
    paste0(
      purrr::map2_chr(
        seq_len(nrow(df)),
        split(df, seq_len(nrow(df))),
        ~ source_card(.y, .x)
      ),
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  } else {
    '<div class="empty-state">No matching sources were found.</div>'
  }

  html <- paste0(
'<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">

<title>RDCD Public Data Discovery Navigator</title>

<style>

:root {
  --primary: #73000A;
  --primary-dark: #5B0008;
  --primary-soft: #F8F1F2;

  --background: #F5F6F8;
  --surface: #FFFFFF;

  --text: #1F2937;
  --text-muted: #6B7280;

  --border: #E5E7EB;
  --border-light: #EEF2F7;

  --good-bg: #DCFCE7;
  --good-text: #166534;

  --medium-bg: #FEF3C7;
  --medium-text: #92400E;

  --low-bg: #FEE2E2;
  --low-text: #991B1B;

  --registered-bg: #E0F2FE;
  --registered-text: #075985;

  --shadow:
    0 8px 24px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.06);
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--background);
  color: var(--text);

  font-family:
    -apple-system,
    BlinkMacSystemFont,
    "Segoe UI",
    Roboto,
    Helvetica,
    Arial,
    sans-serif;

  line-height: 1.55;
}

.page {
  max-width: 1180px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 32px 22px 60px;
}

.hero {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      var(--primary) 0%,
      var(--primary-dark) 100%
    );

  color: white;

  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 34px 38px;

  margin-bottom: 22px;

  box-shadow:
    0 10px 30px rgba(115, 0, 10, 0.18);
}

.hero-kicker {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .10em;
  text-transform: uppercase;

  opacity: .82;

  margin-bottom: 7px;
}

.hero h1 {
  margin: 0;

  font-size: 32px;
  line-height: 1.12;

  font-weight: 800;
}

.hero-subtitle {
  margin-top: 9px;

  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.5;

  color: rgba(255,255,255,.84);
}

.generated {
  margin-top: 14px;

  font-size: 12px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.68);
}

.context-card,
.source-card,
.metric-card {
  background: var(--surface);

  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 16px;

  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}

.context-card {
  padding: 22px 24px;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
}

.section-title {
  color: var(--primary);

  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 800;

  letter-spacing: .07em;
  text-transform: uppercase;

  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.context-label {
  color: var(--text-muted);

  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;

  margin-top: 13px;
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}

.context-value {
  color: var(--text);
  font-size: 14px;
}

.metrics {
  display: grid;

  grid-template-columns:
    repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));

  gap: 14px;

  margin-bottom: 26px;
}

.metric-card {
  padding: 20px 22px;
}

.metric-value {
  color: var(--primary);

  font-size: 28px;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
}

.metric-label {
  margin-top: 7px;

  color: var(--text-muted);

  font-size: 13px;
}

.results-heading {
  display: flex;

  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: end;

  gap: 16px;

  margin: 0 2px 14px;
}

.results-heading h2 {
  margin: 0;

  font-size: 21px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.results-count {
  color: var(--text-muted);

  font-size: 13px;
}

.source-card {
  padding: 25px 26px;

  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.source-header {
  display: flex;

  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;

  gap: 18px;
}

.source-rank {
  color: var(--primary);

  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 800;

  letter-spacing: .08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;

  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.source-title {
  margin: 0;

  font-size: 21px;
  line-height: 1.28;
}

.source-badges {
  display: flex;

  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: flex-end;

  gap: 7px;
}

.badge {
  display: inline-flex;

  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  padding: 5px 10px;

  border-radius: 999px;

  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 800;

  white-space: nowrap;
}

.badge-good,
.access-open {
  background: var(--good-bg);
  color: var(--good-text);
}

.badge-medium,
.access-controlled {
  background: var(--medium-bg);
  color: var(--medium-text);
}

.badge-low,
.access-restricted {
  background: var(--low-bg);
  color: var(--low-text);
}

.access-registered {
  background: var(--registered-bg);
  color: var(--registered-text);
}

.badge-neutral,
.access-other {
  background: #F3F4F6;
  color: #4B5563;
}

.tag-row {
  display: flex;

  flex-wrap: wrap;

  gap: 6px;

  margin-top: 12px;
}

.tag {
  display: inline-flex;

  padding: 4px 8px;

  border-radius: 999px;

  border: 1px solid #E5D3D5;

  background: var(--primary-soft);

  color: var(--primary);

  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.summary-box {
  background: #FAFBFC;

  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-left: 4px solid var(--primary);

  border-radius: 12px;

  padding: 15px 17px;

  margin-top: 18px;
}

.summary-text,
.body-text {
  color: #374151;

  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.65;
}

.details-grid {
  display: grid;

  grid-template-columns:
    repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));

  gap: 10px 16px;
}

.section-block {
  margin-top: 20px;
}

.detail-item {
  padding: 11px 13px;

  background: #FAFBFC;

  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);

  border-radius: 10px;
}

.detail-label {
  color: var(--text-muted);

  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 800;

  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .05em;
}

.detail-value {
  color: var(--text);

  font-size: 13px;

  margin-top: 3px;
}

.callout {
  background: var(--primary-soft);

  border: 1px solid #E5D3D5;

  border-radius: 10px;

  padding: 13px 15px;

  color: #374151;

  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.source-footer {
  margin-top: 20px;

  padding-top: 15px;

  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
}

.source-link {
  color: var(--primary);

  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;

  text-decoration: none;
}

.source-link:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.muted {
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.empty-state {
  background: var(--surface);

  border: 1px solid var(--border);

  border-radius: 14px;

  padding: 40px;

  text-align: center;

  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.footer-note {
  margin-top: 28px;

  padding: 18px 20px;

  border-radius: 14px;

  background: #F8F1F2;

  border: 1px solid #E5D3D5;

  color: #4B5563;

  font-size: 12px;

  line-height: 1.6;
}

@media (max-width: 800px) {

  .page {
    padding: 20px 14px 40px;
  }

  .hero {
    padding: 26px 23px;
  }

  .hero h1 {
    font-size: 27px;
  }

  .metrics {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .details-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .source-header {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .source-badges {
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }
}

@media print {

  body {
    background: white;
  }

  .page {
    max-width: none;
    padding: 0;
  }

  .hero {
    box-shadow: none;
  }

  .context-card,
  .source-card,
  .metric-card {
    box-shadow: none;
    break-inside: avoid;
  }

  .source-card {
    break-inside: avoid-page;
  }

  .source-link {
    color: black;
  }

}

</style>
</head>

DEFAULT_GEO <- c("United States", "South Carolina", "Global/international", "State-level", "County-level", "Census tract", "ZIP/ZCTA", "City", "Hospital/provider")
DEFAULT_ACCESS <- c("Open/public", "Registered public-use", "Registered/controlled", "Credentialed access", "Controlled/restricted", "Public-use plus restricted files", "Open plus controlled data", "Open plus credentialed access", "Open/public with terms")

normalize_geography_token <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(as_text(x))
  x <- stringr::str_squish(x)
  if (length(x) == 0 || nchar(x) == 0 || x %in% c("other", "unknown", "n/a", "na")) return(character())

  dplyr::case_when(
    stringr::str_detect(x, "south carolina|^sc$") ~ "South Carolina",
    stringr::str_detect(x, "global|international|country") ~ "Global/international",
    stringr::str_detect(x, "united states|^us$|^u\\.s\\.?$|national") ~ "United States",
    stringr::str_detect(x, "census tract|tract") ~ "Census tract",
    stringr::str_detect(x, "block group") ~ "Census block group",
    stringr::str_detect(x, "zip|zcta") ~ "ZIP/ZCTA",
    stringr::str_detect(x, "county") ~ "County-level",
    stringr::str_detect(x, "state") ~ "State-level",
    stringr::str_detect(x, "city") ~ "City",
    stringr::str_detect(x, "hospital|health system|facility|provider") ~ "Hospital/provider",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ) |>
    stats::na.omit() |>
    as.character()
}

geography_filter_choices <- function(df) {
  raw_values <- c(safe_col(df, "geography_coverage"), safe_col(df, "geographic_unit"))
  raw_tokens <- unlist(stringr::str_split(raw_values, "[,;/\\n\\r]+|\\s+and\\s+|\\s+or\\s+"))
  normalized <- unique(unlist(purrr::map(raw_tokens, normalize_geography_token)))
  normalized <- sort(normalized[nchar(normalized) > 0])
  unique(c(DEFAULT_GEO, normalized))
}

  padding: 5px 9px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #F8F1F2;
  border: 1px solid #E5D3D5;
  color: #73000A;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.rdcd-source-card-footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: auto;
  padding-top: 18px;
}

.rdcd-source-card-link {
  color: #73000A;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.rdcd-source-card-link:hover {
  color: #5B0008;
  text-decoration: underline;
}

/* Stack cards on smaller screens */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .rdcd-source-card-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .rdcd-source-card {
    padding: 16px;
  }

  .rdcd-source-card-header {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
}

/* -------------------------------------------------
   Side-by-side source comparison
   ------------------------------------------------- */

.rdcd-app .compare-sources-note {
  color: #6B7280;
  font-size: 13px;
  margin-top: 6px;
}

      .small-note {
        font-size: 90%;
        color: #6B7280;
      }

      .fit-summary-shell {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 12px;
      }

      .fit-summary-hero {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #73000A 0%, #5B0008 100%);
        color: #FFFFFF;
        border-radius: 16px;
        padding: 20px 22px;
        box-shadow: none;
      }

      .fit-summary-kicker {
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        opacity: 0.9;
        margin-bottom: 6px;
      }

      .fit-summary-hero h3 {
        margin: 0 0 8px 0;
        font-size: 24px;
        font-weight: 800;
      }

      .fit-summary-lead {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: 15px;
        opacity: 0.95;
        max-width: 860px;
      }

      .fit-summary-callout {
        background: #FFFFFF;
        border: 1px solid #EEF2F7;
        border-left: 4px solid #73000A;
        border-radius: 14px;
        padding: 16px 18px;
        box-shadow: none;
      }

      .fit-summary-pre {
        margin: 0;
        white-space: pre-wrap;
        word-wrap: break-word;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 15px;
        line-height: 1.6;
        color: #333333;
        background: transparent;
        border: none;
        padding: 0;
      }

      .fit-summary-actions {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        margin-top: 4px;
      }

      .rdcd-app .well {
        background: transparent;
        border: none;
        box-shadow: none;
        padding: 0;
        margin-bottom: 0;
      }

      .tooltip {
        z-index: 9999 !important;
      }

      .tooltip-inner {
        max-width: 450px !important;
        padding: 12px 14px !important;
        font-size: 12px !important;
        font-weight: 400 !important;
        line-height: 1.5 !important;
        text-align: left !important;
        white-space: normal !important;
      }

      td.limitations-cell {
        width: 125px !important;
        min-width: 125px !important;
        max-width: 125px !important;
        white-space: nowrap;
        vertical-align: top;
      }

      .limitations-trigger {
          display: inline-block;
          color: #0066CC;
          cursor: pointer;
          font-size: 12px;
          font-weight: 600;
          line-height: 1.2;
          white-space: nowrap;
          text-decoration: underline;
          text-underline-offset: 2px;
        }

      .limitations-trigger:hover {
        color: #004C99;
        text-decoration-thickness: 2px;
      }

      .limitations-trigger:focus {
        outline: 2px solid rgba(115, 0, 10, 0.3);
        outline-offset: 3px;
        border-radius: 2px;
      }

      .limitations-empty {
        color: #6B7280;
        font-size: 12px;
        font-style: italic;
      }
      
      /* -------------------------------------------------
   Increased spacing / modernized layout
   ------------------------------------------------- */

/* More breathing room between inputs */
.rdcd-app .shiny-input-container,
.rdcd-app .form-group {
  margin-bottom: 18px !important;
}

/* Give text fields and dropdowns more internal space */
.rdcd-app .form-control {
  padding: 10px 12px !important;
  min-height: 42px;
}

/* More comfortable Selectize dropdowns */
.rdcd-app .selectize-input {
  padding: 10px 12px !important;
  min-height: 42px !important;
}

/* More space around sidebar section headings */
.rdcd-app .rdcd-section-label {
  margin-bottom: 14px !important;
  padding-top: 4px;
}

/* More room between major sidebar sections */
.rdcd-app .rdcd-section {
  margin-bottom: 28px !important;
}

/* More space inside expanded Filters */
.rdcd-app .rdcd-details-body {
  margin-top: 16px !important;
}

/* More comfortable filter heading */
.rdcd-app .rdcd-details summary {
  padding: 6px 0;
}

/* More breathing room around tabs */
.rdcd-app .nav-tabs > li > a,
.rdcd-app .nav-tabs .nav-link {
  padding: 12px 16px !important;
  margin-right: 6px;
}

/* More space between tabs and their content */
/* -------------------------------------------------
   Space between tab navigation and tab content
   ------------------------------------------------- */

.rdcd-app .tab-content {
  padding-top: 0 !important;
}

.rdcd-app .tab-content > .tab-pane {
  padding-top: 28px !important;
}

/* Keep the first major content element from
   immediately touching the tab area */
.rdcd-app .tab-content > .tab-pane.active {
  padding-top: 28px !important;
}

.rdcd-start-state {
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding: 28px;
  background: #FFFFFF;
  border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.04),
              0 6px 18px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.05);
}

.rdcd-start-state h3 {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  color: #1F2937;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.rdcd-start-state p {
  margin: 0;
  color: #6B7280;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}


.rdcd-context-matches {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.rdcd-context-filters {
  flex: 1;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.rdcd-context-sort {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.rdcd-context-value {
  color: #73000A;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.rdcd-context-label {
  color: #4B5563;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.rdcd-context-text {
  color: #6B7280;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;

  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}


/* Stack gracefully on smaller screens */
@media (max-width: 900px) {

  .rdcd-results-context {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 10px 14px;
  }

  .rdcd-context-divider {
    display: none;
  }

  .rdcd-context-filters {
    flex-basis: 100%;
    order: 3;
  }
}

/* -------------------------------------------------
   Empty results state
   ------------------------------------------------- */

.rdcd-empty-state {
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding: 42px 28px;
  text-align: center;

  background: #FFFFFF;
  border-radius: 14px;

  box-shadow:
    0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.04),
    0 6px 18px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.05);
}


.rdcd-empty-state h3 {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  color: #1F2937;

  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.rdcd-empty-state p {
  max-width: 520px;
  margin: 0 auto;

  color: #6B7280;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------
   Cleaner results data table
   ------------------------------------------------- */

.rdcd-app .dataTables_wrapper table.dataTable {
  border-collapse: separate !important;
  border-spacing: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}

/* Stronger, cleaner header */
.rdcd-app .dataTables_wrapper table.dataTable thead th {
  background: #F9FAFB !important;
  color: #1F2937 !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  padding: 12px 14px !important;
  vertical-align: middle;

  border-top: 1px solid #E5E7EB !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #E5E7EB !important;
}

/* More comfortable row height + lighter borders */
.rdcd-app .dataTables_wrapper table.dataTable tbody td {
  padding: 13px 14px !important;
  vertical-align: middle;

  border-top: 1px solid #EEF2F7 !important;
  border-bottom: none !important;
}

/* Zebra striping */
.rdcd-app .dataTables_wrapper table.dataTable.stripe tbody tr:nth-child(odd) {
  background-color: #FAFBFC !important;
}

.rdcd-app .dataTables_wrapper table.dataTable.stripe tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
  background-color: #FFFFFF !important;
}

/* Row hover */
.rdcd-app .dataTables_wrapper table.dataTable.hover tbody tr:hover {
  background-color: #F8F1F2 !important;
}

/* Smooth hover transition */
.rdcd-app .dataTables_wrapper table.dataTable tbody tr {
  transition: background-color 0.12s ease;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------
   Score + access badges
   ------------------------------------------------- */

.rdcd-app .score-badge,
.rdcd-app .access-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  padding: 4px 9px;
  border-radius: 999px;

  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.2;

  white-space: nowrap;
}


/* Match score badges */

.rdcd-app .score-high {
  background: #DCFCE7;
  color: #166534;
}

.rdcd-app .score-medium {
  background: #FEF3C7;
  color: #92400E;
}

.rdcd-app .score-low {
  background: #FEE2E2;
  color: #991B1B;
}


/* Access badges */

.rdcd-app .access-open {
  background: #DCFCE7;
  color: #166534;
}

.rdcd-app .access-registered {
  background: #E0F2FE;
  color: #075985;
}

.rdcd-app .access-controlled {
  background: #FEF3C7;
  color: #92400E;
}

.rdcd-app .access-restricted {
  background: #FEE2E2;
  color: #991B1B;
}

.rdcd-app .access-other {
  background: #F3F4F6;
  color: #4B5563;
}

/* More generous result cards */
.rdcd-app .data-card {
  padding: 22px !important;
  margin-bottom: 16px !important;
}

/* More generous Data Fit Summary hero */
.rdcd-app .fit-summary-hero {
  padding: 26px 28px !important;
}

/* More space inside summary cards */
.rdcd-app .fit-summary-callout {
  padding: 22px 24px !important;
}

/* More space between summary components */
.rdcd-app .fit-summary-shell {
  gap: 18px !important;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------
   Dashboard summary card
   ------------------------------------------------- */

.dashboard-summary-card {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;

  /* Same visual shape as title banner */
  background: #F8F1F2;
  border: 1px solid #E5D3D5;
  border-radius: 14px;

  padding: 20px 30px;
  margin-bottom: 30px;

  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(31, 41, 55, 0.08);
}

/* Each metric stays on one line */
.dashboard-metric {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 7px;

  flex: 1;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* Bold metric numbers */
.dashboard-metric-value {
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  line-height: 1;
  color: #73000A;
}

/* Metric description */
.dashboard-metric-label {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #4B5563;
}

/* Light separators */
.dashboard-metric-divider {
  width: 1px;
  height: 24px;
  background: #D8C7C9;
  margin: 0 18px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------
   Sticky sidebar
   ------------------------------------------------- */

.rdcd-sidebar-column {
  z-index: 5;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .rdcd-sidebar-column {
    position: static !important;
    top: auto !important;
    z-index: auto;
  }
}

/* Responsive */
}

})

raw_catalog <- reactive({
  load_catalog(current_path())
})

processed_catalog <- reactive({
  prepare_catalog(raw_catalog())
})

observe({
  df <- processed_catalog()
  category_choices <- unique(c(DEFAULT_CATEGORIES, as_text(df$category_for_filter)))
  category_choices <- sort(category_choices[nchar(category_choices) > 0])
  data_type_choices <- unique(c(DEFAULT_DATA_TYPES, df$data_type_for_filter))
  data_type_choices <- sort(data_type_choices[nchar(data_type_choices) > 0])
  geography_choices <- geography_filter_choices(df)
  access_choices <- unique(c(DEFAULT_ACCESS, df$access_level_standardized))
  access_choices <- sort(access_choices[nchar(access_choices) > 0])

  updateSelectizeInput(session, "category_filter", choices = category_choices, server = TRUE)
  updateSelectizeInput(session, "data_type_filter", choices = data_type_choices, server = TRUE)
  updateSelectizeInput(session, "geography_filter", choices = geography_choices, server = TRUE)
  updateSelectizeInput(session, "access_filter", choices = access_choices, server = TRUE)
})



search_terms <- eventReactive(
  input$run_search,
  {

    question_text <- as_text(input$question)
    keyword_text <- as_text(input$keyword_string)

    # Server-side character validation
    if (nchar(question_text) > MAX_QUESTION_CHARS) {
      showNotification(
        paste0(
          "Research Question must be ",
          MAX_QUESTION_CHARS,
          " characters or fewer."
        ),
        type = "error",
        duration = 6
      )
      return(character())
    }

    if (nchar(keyword_text) > MAX_KEYWORD_CHARS) {
      showNotification(
        paste0(
          "Keywords must be ",
          MAX_KEYWORD_CHARS,
          " characters or fewer."
        ),
        type = "error",
        duration = 6
      )
      return(character())
    }

question_terms <- extract_words(question_text)

keyword_terms <- parse_search_terms(
  keyword_text
)

original_terms <- unique(c(
  question_terms,
  keyword_terms
))

original_terms <- original_terms[
  nchar(original_terms) >= 2
]

original_terms <- unique(
  vapply(
    original_terms,
    normalize_search_term,
    character(1)
  )
)

expanded_terms <- if (isTRUE(input$use_category_expansion)) {
  expand_terms(original_terms)
} else {
  character()
}

expanded_terms <- setdiff(
  expanded_terms,
  original_terms
)

list(
  original = original_terms,
  expanded = expanded_terms
)
  },
  ignoreNULL = FALSE
)


scored_results <- eventReactive(
  input$run_search,
  {

    session$sendCustomMessage(
      "rdcdToggleSearch",
      TRUE
    )

    on.exit(
      session$sendCustomMessage(
        "rdcdToggleSearch",
        FALSE
      ),
      add = TRUE
    )

    withProgress(
      message = "Searching sources...",
      value = 0,
      {

        incProgress(0.3)

       terms <- search_terms()

res <- score_catalog(
  df = processed_catalog(),
  original_terms = terms$original,
  expanded_terms = terms$expanded,
  category_filter = input$category_filter %||% character(),
  data_type_filter = input$data_type_filter %||% character(),
  geography_filter = input$geography_filter %||% character(),
  access_filter = input$access_filter %||% character(),
  open_only = input$open_only
) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    match_score >= input$min_score
  )

        incProgress(0.7)

        res
      }
    )

  },
  ignoreNULL = FALSE
)

output$question_char_count <- renderUI({

  n <- nchar(input$question %||% "")

  counter_class <- if (n >= MAX_QUESTION_CHARS) {
    "search-char-count limit-reached"
  } else if (n >= MAX_QUESTION_CHARS * 0.9) {
    "search-char-count limit-near"
  } else {
    "search-char-count"
  }

  tags$div(
    class = counter_class,
    paste0(
      n,
      " / ",
      MAX_QUESTION_CHARS,
      " characters"
    )
  )
})


output$keyword_char_count <- renderUI({

  n <- nchar(input$keyword_string %||% "")

  } else if (n >= MAX_KEYWORD_CHARS * 0.9) {
    "search-char-count limit-near"
  } else {
    "search-char-count"
  }

  tags$div(
    class = counter_class,
    paste0(
      n,
      " / ",
      MAX_KEYWORD_CHARS,
      " characters"
    )
  )
})

# -------------------------------------------------
# Enforce search input character limits
# -------------------------------------------------

observeEvent(input$question, {

  question_text <- input$question %||% ""

  if (nchar(question_text) > MAX_QUESTION_CHARS) {

    updateTextAreaInput(
      session,
      "question",
      value = substr(
        question_text,
        1,
        MAX_QUESTION_CHARS
      )
    )
  }
})


observeEvent(input$keyword_string, {

  keyword_text <- input$keyword_string %||% ""

  if (nchar(keyword_text) > MAX_KEYWORD_CHARS) {

    updateTextInput(
      session,
      "keyword_string",
      value = substr(
        keyword_text,
        1,
        MAX_KEYWORD_CHARS
      )
    )
  }
})

)
})

})

output$source_cards <- renderUI({

  df <- scored_results() |>
    dplyr::slice_head(n = min(10, input$top_n))

  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(
      tags$div(
        style = paste(
          "padding:40px;",
          "text-align:center;",
          "background:#FFFFFF;",
          "border:1px solid #E5E7EB;",
          "border-radius:14px;"
        ),
        tags$h3("No matching sources"),
        tags$p("No data sources meet the current criteria.")
      )
    )
  }

  cards <- purrr::map(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {

    row <- df[i, ]

    # -----------------------------
    # Summary
    # -----------------------------
    summary_text <- as_text(row$main_data_type_use)

    if (!nzchar(summary_text)) {
      summary_text <- as_text(row$suggested_use_cases)
    }

    if (!nzchar(summary_text)) {
      summary_text <- "No summary is available for this source."
    }

    if (nchar(summary_text) > 240) {
      summary_text <- paste0(substr(summary_text, 1, 237), "...")
    }

    # -----------------------------
    # Tags
    # -----------------------------
    raw_tags <- c(
      split_terms(row$primary_category),
      split_terms(row$secondary_categories_tags),
      split_terms(row$data_type_for_filter),
      split_terms(row$geography_coverage)
    )

    tags_vec <- unique(raw_tags[nchar(raw_tags) > 0])
    tags_vec <- head(tags_vec, 8)

    tag_html <- if (length(tags_vec) > 0) {

      purrr::map(
        tags_vec,
        function(tag) {
          tags$span(
            style = paste(
              "display:inline-block;",
              "padding:5px 9px;",
              "margin:0 5px 5px 0;",
              "border-radius:999px;",
              "background:#F8F1F2;",
              "border:1px solid #E5D3D5;",
              "color:#73000A;",
              "font-size:11px;",
              "font-weight:700;"
            ),
            tag
          )
        }
      )

    } else {

      list(
        tags$span(
          style = "color:#6B7280;font-size:12px;",
          "No tags available."
        )
      )
    }

    # -----------------------------
    # Score styling
    # -----------------------------
    score <- as.numeric(row$match_score)

    score_bg <- if (is.na(score)) {
      "#F3F4F6"
    } else if (score >= 70) {
      "#DCFCE7"
    } else if (score >= 40) {
      "#FEF3C7"
    } else {
      "#FEE2E2"
    }

    score_fg <- if (is.na(score)) {
      "#4B5563"
    } else if (score >= 70) {
      "#166534"
    } else if (score >= 40) {
      "#92400E"
    } else {
      "#991B1B"
    }

    # -----------------------------
    # Access styling
    # -----------------------------
    access <- tolower(as_text(row$access_level_standardized))

    if (stringr::str_detect(access, "restricted")) {

      access_label <- "Restricted"
      access_bg <- "#FEE2E2"
      access_fg <- "#991B1B"

    } else if (stringr::str_detect(access, "controlled|credentialed")) {

      access_label <- "Controlled"
      access_bg <- "#FEF3C7"
      access_fg <- "#92400E"

    } else if (stringr::str_detect(access, "registered")) {

      access_label <- "Registered"
      access_bg <- "#E0F2FE"
      access_fg <- "#075985"

    } else if (stringr::str_detect(access, "open|public")) {

      access_label <- "Open"
      access_bg <- "#DCFCE7"
      access_fg <- "#166534"

    } else {

      access_label <- "Unknown"
      access_bg <- "#F3F4F6"
      access_fg <- "#4B5563"
    }

    # -----------------------------
    # Official link
    # -----------------------------
    official_link <- if (
      !is.na(row$official_url) &&
      nchar(row$official_url) > 0
    ) {

      tags$a(
        href = row$official_url,
        target = "_blank",
        rel = "noopener noreferrer",
        style = paste(
          "color:#73000A;",
          "font-size:13px;",
          "font-weight:700;",
          "text-decoration:none;"
        ),
        "Open official source"
      )

    } else {

      tags$span(
        style = "color:#6B7280;font-size:12px;",
        "No official link provided"
      )
    }

    # -----------------------------
    # CARD
    # -----------------------------
    tags$div(
      style = paste(
        "background:#FFFFFF;",
        "border:1px solid #E5E7EB;",
        "border-radius:14px;",
        "padding:20px;",
        "box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(31,41,55,0.06);",
        "display:flex;",
        "flex-direction:column;",
        "min-width:0;",
        "height:100%;"
      ),

      # Header
      tags$div(
        style = paste(
          "display:flex;",
          "justify-content:space-between;",
          "align-items:flex-start;",
          "gap:12px;",
          "margin-bottom:16px;"
        ),

        tags$h4(
          style = paste(
            "margin:0;",
            "font-size:18px;",
            "font-weight:800;",
            "line-height:1.3;",
            "color:#1F2937;"
          ),
          row$data_source
        ),

        tags$div(
          style = paste(
            "display:flex;",
            "gap:6px;",
            "align-items:center;",
            "flex-wrap:wrap;",
            "justify-content:flex-end;"
          ),

          # Match score
          tags$span(
            style = paste(
              "display:inline-flex;",
              "align-items:center;",
              "padding:5px 9px;",
              "border-radius:999px;",
              "background:", score_bg, ";",
              "color:", score_fg, ";",
              "font-size:12px;",
              "font-weight:700;",
              "white-space:nowrap;"
            ),
            if (is.na(score)) "N/A" else paste0(round(score), "% match")
          ),

          # Access
          tags$span(
            style = paste(
              "display:inline-flex;",
              "align-items:center;",
              "padding:5px 9px;",
              "border-radius:999px;",
              "background:", access_bg, ";",
              "color:", access_fg, ";",
              "font-size:12px;",
              "font-weight:700;",
              "white-space:nowrap;"
            ),
            access_label
          )
        )
      ),

      # Summary
      tags$div(
        style = "margin-bottom:16px;",

        tags$div(
          style = paste(
            "font-size:11px;",
            "font-weight:800;",
            "text-transform:uppercase;",
            "letter-spacing:0.05em;",
            "color:#6B7280;",
            "margin-bottom:5px;"
          ),
          "Summary"
        ),

        tags$p(
          style = paste(
            "margin:0;",
            "font-size:14px;",
            "line-height:1.6;",
            "color:#4B5563;"
          ),
          summary_text
        )
      ),

      # Tags
      tags$div(
        style = "margin-bottom:18px;",

        tags$div(
          style = paste(
            "font-size:11px;",
            "font-weight:800;",
            "text-transform:uppercase;",
            "letter-spacing:0.05em;",
            "color:#6B7280;",
            "margin-bottom:7px;"
          ),
          "Tags"
        ),

        tags$div(
          tag_html
        )
      ),

      # Footer
      tags$div(
        style = paste(
          "margin-top:auto;",
          "padding-top:14px;",
          "border-top:1px solid #EEF2F7;"
        ),
        official_link
      )
    )
  })

  # -----------------------------
  # 2-column card grid
  # -----------------------------
  tags$div(
    style = paste(
      "display:grid;",
      "grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));",
      "gap:18px;",
      "margin-top:18px;"
    ),
    cards
  )
})
