          "text-align:center;",
          "background:#FFFFFF;",
          "border:1px solid #E5E7EB;",
          "border-radius:14px;",
          "color:#6B7280;"
        ),

        tags$h4(
          style = "margin:0 0 8px;color:#1F2937;",
          "Choose at least two sources"
        ),

        tags$p(
          style = "margin:0;",
          "Select 2-5 sources above to compare them side-by-side."
        )
      )
    )
  }

  if (length(selected) > 5) {

    return(
      tags$div(
        style = paste0(
          "padding:24px;",
          "background:#FEF3C7;",
          "border:1px solid #FDE68A;",
          "border-radius:12px;",
          "color:#92400E;",
          "font-weight:600;"
        ),
        "Choose no more than five sources."
      )
    )
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Get selected sources
  # -------------------------------------------------

  df <- scored_results() |>
    dplyr::filter(data_source %in% selected)

  # Preserve the order selected by the user
  df$data_source <- factor(
    df$data_source,
    levels = selected
  )

  df <- df |>
    dplyr::arrange(data_source)
  
  # -------------------------------------------------
# Search coverage
# -------------------------------------------------

terms_for_display <- search_terms()$original %||% character()

coverage_rows <- if (length(terms_for_display) > 0) {

  purrr::map(
    terms_for_display,
    function(term) {

      normalized_term <- normalize_search_term(term)

      list(
        label = term,
        values = purrr::map(
          seq_len(nrow(df)),
          function(i) {

            row <- df[i, ]

            hit <- stringr::str_detect(
              row$search_text_normalized,
              stringr::fixed(
                normalized_term,
                ignore_case = TRUE
              )
            )

            if (isTRUE(hit)) {
              tags$span(
                style = paste0(
                  "display:inline-flex;",
                  "align-items:center;",
                  "padding:4px 9px;",
                  "border-radius:999px;",
                  "background:#DCFCE7;",
                  "color:#166534;",
                  "font-size:12px;",
                  "font-weight:700;"
                ),
                "\u2713 Found"
              )
            } else {
              tags$span(
                style = paste0(
                  "display:inline-flex;",
                  "align-items:center;",
                  "padding:4px 9px;",
                  "border-radius:999px;",
                  "background:#FEE2E2;",
                  "color:#991B1B;",
                  "font-size:12px;",
                  "font-weight:700;"
                ),
                "\u2717 Not found"
              )
            }
          }
        )
      )
    }
  )

} else {
  list()
}

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Shared grid definition
  #
  # IMPORTANT:
  # Every row in the comparison uses this exact
  # same grid so the columns always line up.
  # -------------------------------------------------

  label_width <- 180
  source_width <- 190

  comparison_grid <- paste0(
    "display:grid;",
    "grid-template-columns:",
    label_width,
    "px repeat(",
    nrow(df),
    ", minmax(",
    source_width,
    "px, 1fr));",
    "min-width:",
    label_width + (nrow(df) * source_width),
    "px;"
  )
  
  search_coverage_rows <- purrr::map(
  coverage_rows,
  function(item) {

    tags$div(
      style = paste0(
        comparison_grid,
        "border-top:1px solid #EEF2F7;"
      ),

      tags$div(
        style = paste0(
          "padding:12px 14px;",
          "background:#F9FAFB;",
          "border-right:1px solid #EEF2F7;",
          "font-size:11px;",
          "font-weight:800;",
          "text-transform:uppercase;",
          "letter-spacing:0.04em;",
          "color:#6B7280;"
        ),
        item$label
      ),

      purrr::map(
        item$values,
        function(value) {

          tags$div(
            style = paste0(
              "padding:12px 14px;",
              "background:#FFFFFF;",
              "border-right:1px solid #EEF2F7;",
              "min-width:0;"
            ),
            value
          )
        }
      )
    )
  }
)

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Helper: normalize displayed values
  # -------------------------------------------------

  display_value <- function(x) {

    x <- as_text(x)

    if (!nzchar(x)) {

      return(
        tags$span(
          style = paste0(
            "color:#9CA3AF;",
            "font-style:italic;",
            "font-size:12px;"
          ),
          "Not specified"
        )
      )
    }

    tags$span(
      style = paste0(
        "display:block;",
        "font-size:13px;",
        "line-height:1.5;",
        "color:#374151;",
        "white-space:normal;",
        "overflow-wrap:anywhere;",
        "word-break:break-word;"
      ),
      x
    )
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Helper: access styling
  # -------------------------------------------------

  get_access_style <- function(access_text) {

    access <- tolower(as_text(access_text))

    if (stringr::str_detect(access, "restricted")) {

      list(
        label = "Restricted",
        bg = "#FEE2E2",
        fg = "#991B1B"
      )

    } else if (stringr::str_detect(access, "controlled|credentialed")) {

      list(
        label = "Controlled",
        bg = "#FEF3C7",
        fg = "#92400E"
      )

    } else if (stringr::str_detect(access, "registered")) {

      list(
        label = "Registered",
        bg = "#E0F2FE",
        fg = "#075985"
      )

    } else if (stringr::str_detect(access, "open|public")) {

      list(
        label = "Open",
        bg = "#DCFCE7",
        fg = "#166534"
      )

    } else {

      list(
        label = "Unknown",
        bg = "#F3F4F6",
        fg = "#4B5563"
      )
    }
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Helper: score styling
  # -------------------------------------------------

  get_score_style <- function(score) {

    score <- as.numeric(score)

    if (is.na(score)) {

      return(
        list(
          label = "N/A",
          bg = "#F3F4F6",
          fg = "#4B5563"
        )
      )
    }

    if (score >= 70) {

      list(
        label = paste0(round(score), "%"),
        bg = "#DCFCE7",
        fg = "#166534"
      )

    } else if (score >= 40) {

      list(
        label = paste0(round(score), "%"),
        bg = "#FEF3C7",
        fg = "#92400E"
      )

    } else {

      list(
        label = paste0(round(score), "%"),
        bg = "#FEE2E2",
        fg = "#991B1B"
      )
    }
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Header row
  # -------------------------------------------------

  source_headers <- purrr::map(
    seq_len(nrow(df)),
    function(i) {

      row <- df[i, ]

      tags$div(
        style = paste0(
          "padding:16px 14px;",
          "background:#F8F1F2;",
          "border-right:1px solid #E5D3D5;",
          "min-width:0;",
          "overflow-wrap:anywhere;",
          "word-break:break-word;"
        ),

        tags$div(
          style = paste0(
            "font-size:15px;",
            "font-weight:800;",
            "line-height:1.3;",
            "color:#73000A;",
            "white-space:normal;",
            "overflow-wrap:anywhere;",
            "word-break:break-word;"
          ),
          as.character(row$data_source)
        ),

        tags$div(
          style = paste0(
            "margin-top:6px;",
            "font-size:11px;",
            "font-weight:600;",
            "color:#6B7280;"
          ),
          paste0("Rank #", i)
        )
      )
    }
  )

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Quick view row
  # -------------------------------------------------

  quick_view_cells <- purrr::map(
    seq_len(nrow(df)),
    function(i) {

      row <- df[i, ]

      score_style <- get_score_style(row$match_score)
      access_style <- get_access_style(row$access_level_standardized)

      tags$div(
        style = paste0(
          "padding:12px 14px;",
          "background:#FFFFFF;",
          "border-right:1px solid #EEF2F7;",
          "min-width:0;",
          "overflow-wrap:anywhere;"
        ),

        tags$div(
          style = "margin-bottom:6px;",

          tags$span(
            style = paste0(
              "display:inline-flex;",
              "align-items:center;",
              "padding:4px 8px;",
              "border-radius:999px;",
              "background:",
              score_style$bg,
              ";",
              "color:",
              score_style$fg,
              ";",
              "font-size:11px;",
              "font-weight:700;",
              "white-space:nowrap;"
            ),
            paste0(score_style$label, " match")
          )
        ),

        tags$span(
          style = paste0(
            "display:inline-flex;",
            "align-items:center;",
            "padding:4px 8px;",
            "border-radius:999px;",
            "background:",
            access_style$bg,
            ";",
            "color:",
            access_style$fg,
            ";",
            "font-size:11px;",
            "font-weight:700;",
            "white-space:nowrap;"
          ),
          access_style$label
        )
      )
    }
  )

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Comparison fields
  # -------------------------------------------------

  comparison_rows <- list(

    list(
      label = "Match Score",
      values = df$match_score
    ),

    list(
      label = "Access",
      values = df$access_level_standardized
    ),

    list(
      label = "Access Burden",
      values = df$access_burden_for_filter
    ),

    list(
      label = "Category",
      values = df$category_for_filter
    ),

    list(
      label = "Data Type",
      values = df$data_type_for_filter
    ),

    list(
      label = "Population",
      values = df$population
    ),

    list(
      label = "Geography",
      values = df$geography_coverage
    ),

    list(
      label = "Unit of Analysis",
      values = df$unit_of_analysis
    ),

    list(
      label = "Years",
      values = df$years_available
    ),

    list(
      label = "Linkage Potential",
      values = df$linkage_potential
    ),

    list(
      label = "South Carolina Relevance",
      values = df$south_carolina_relevance
    )
  )

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Standard comparison rows
  # -------------------------------------------------

  matrix_rows <- purrr::map(
    comparison_rows,
    function(item) {

      tags$div(
        style = paste0(
          comparison_grid,
          "border-top:1px solid #EEF2F7;"
        ),

        # Row label
        tags$div(
          style = paste0(
            "padding:12px 14px;",
            "background:#F9FAFB;",
            "border-right:1px solid #EEF2F7;",
            "font-size:11px;",
            "font-weight:800;",
            "text-transform:uppercase;",
            "letter-spacing:0.04em;",
            "color:#6B7280;",
            "min-width:0;",
            "overflow-wrap:anywhere;",
            "word-break:break-word;"
          ),
          item$label
        ),

        # Source values
        purrr::map(
          item$values,
          function(value) {

            tags$div(
              style = paste0(
                "padding:12px 14px;",
                "background:#FFFFFF;",
                "border-right:1px solid #EEF2F7;",
                "min-width:0;",
                "overflow-wrap:anywhere;",
                "word-break:break-word;"
              ),
              display_value(value)
            )
          }
        )
      )
    }
  )

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Limitations row
  # -------------------------------------------------

  limitations_cells <- purrr::map(
    seq_len(nrow(df)),
    function(i) {

      row <- df[i, ]
      txt <- as_text(row$limitations_cautions)

      tags$div(
        style = paste0(
          "padding:12px 14px;",
          "background:#FFFFFF;",
          "border-right:1px solid #EEF2F7;",
          "min-width:0;",
          "overflow-wrap:anywhere;"
        ),

        if (nzchar(txt)) {

          tags$details(

            tags$summary(
              style = paste0(
                "cursor:pointer;",
                "color:#73000A;",
                "font-size:12px;",
                "font-weight:700;"
              ),
              "View limitations"
            ),

            tags$p(
              style = paste0(
                "margin:8px 0 0;",
                "font-size:12px;",
                "line-height:1.5;",
                "color:#4B5563;",
                "white-space:normal;",
                "overflow-wrap:anywhere;",
                "word-break:break-word;"
              ),
              txt
            )
          )

        } else {

          tags$span(
            style = "color:#9CA3AF;font-size:12px;",
            "Not specified"
          )
        }
      )
    }
  )

  limitations_row <- tags$div(
    style = paste0(
      comparison_grid,
      "border-top:1px solid #EEF2F7;"
    ),

    tags$div(
      style = paste0(
        "padding:12px 14px;",
        "background:#F9FAFB;",
        "border-right:1px solid #EEF2F7;",
        "font-size:11px;",
        "font-weight:800;",
        "text-transform:uppercase;",
        "letter-spacing:0.04em;",
        "color:#6B7280;"
      ),
      "Limitations"
    ),

    limitations_cells
  )

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Official source links
  # -------------------------------------------------

  links_cells <- purrr::map(
    seq_len(nrow(df)),
    function(i) {

      row <- df[i, ]

      if (
        !is.na(row$official_url) &&
        nchar(row$official_url) > 0
      ) {

        tags$div(
          style = paste0(
            "padding:14px;",
            "background:#FFFFFF;",
            "border-right:1px solid #EEF2F7;",
            "min-width:0;"
          ),

          tags$a(
            href = row$official_url,
            target = "_blank",
            rel = "noopener noreferrer",
            style = paste0(
              "font-size:12px;",
              "font-weight:700;",
              "color:#73000A;",
              "text-decoration:none;"
            ),
            "Open source"
          )
        )

      } else {

        tags$div(
          style = paste0(
            "padding:14px;",
            "background:#FFFFFF;",
            "border-right:1px solid #EEF2F7;",
            "color:#9CA3AF;",
            "font-size:12px;",
            "min-width:0;"
          ),
          "Not available"
        )
      }
    }
  )

  links_row <- tags$div(
    style = paste0(
      comparison_grid,
      "border-top:1px solid #EEF2F7;"
    ),

    tags$div(
      style = paste0(
        "padding:14px;",
        "background:#F9FAFB;",
        "border-right:1px solid #EEF2F7;",
        "font-size:11px;",
        "font-weight:800;",
        "text-transform:uppercase;",
        "letter-spacing:0.04em;",
        "color:#6B7280;"
      ),
      "Official Source"
    ),

    links_cells
  )

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Final comparison matrix
  # -------------------------------------------------

  tags$div(

    style = paste0(
      "background:#FFFFFF;",
      "border:1px solid #E5E7EB;",
      "border-radius:14px;",
      "overflow-x:auto;",
      "overflow-y:hidden;",
      "width:100%;",
      "box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(31,41,55,0.05);"
    ),

    # Header
    tags$div(
      style = comparison_grid,

      tags$div(
        style = paste0(
          "padding:16px 14px;",
          "background:#73000A;",
          "color:#FFFFFF;",
          "font-size:11px;",
          "font-weight:800;",
          "text-transform:uppercase;",
          "letter-spacing:0.05em;",
          "display:flex;",
          "align-items:center;",
          "min-width:0;"
        ),
        "Compare"
      ),

      source_headers
    ),

    # Quick view
    tags$div(
      style = paste0(
        comparison_grid,
        "border-top:1px solid #EEF2F7;"
      ),

      tags$div(
        style = paste0(
          "padding:12px 14px;",
          "background:#F9FAFB;",
          "border-right:1px solid #EEF2F7;",
          "font-size:11px;",
          "font-weight:800;",
          "text-transform:uppercase;",
          "letter-spacing:0.04em;",
          "color:#6B7280;"
        ),
        "Quick View"
      ),

      quick_view_cells
    ),
    
    # Search coverage
tags$div(
  style = paste0(
    comparison_grid,
    "border-top:1px solid #EEF2F7;"
  ),

  tags$div(
    style = paste0(
      "padding:12px 14px;",
      "background:#F8F1F2;",
      "border-right:1px solid #E5D3D5;",
      "font-size:11px;",
      "font-weight:800;",
      "text-transform:uppercase;",
      "letter-spacing:0.04em;",
      "color:#73000A;"
    ),
    "Search Coverage"
  ),

  purrr::map(
    seq_len(nrow(df)),
    function(i) {

      row <- df[i, ]

      matched_n <- as.numeric(row$original_terms_matched_n)
      total_n <- as.numeric(row$original_terms_total_n)

      tags$div(
        style = paste0(
          "padding:12px 14px;",
          "background:#F8F1F2;",
          "border-right:1px solid #E5D3D5;",
          "min-width:0;"
        ),

        tags$div(
          style = paste0(
            "font-size:12px;",
            "font-weight:800;",
            "color:#73000A;",
            "margin-bottom:6px;"
          ),
          paste0(
            matched_n,
            " of ",
            total_n,
            " concepts matched"
          )
        ),

        tags$div(
          style = paste0(
            "font-size:11px;",
            "color:#6B7280;",
            "line-height:1.4;"
          ),
          paste0(
            round(as.numeric(row$original_term_coverage)),
            "% search coverage"
          )
        )
      )
    }
  )
),

search_coverage_rows,

    # Main rows
    matrix_rows,

    # Limitations
    limitations_row,

    # Official source
    links_row
  )
})

output$visual_summary_tiles <- renderUI({

  df <- scored_results()

  n_sources <- nrow(df)

  avg_score <- if (n_sources > 0) {
    round(mean(df$match_score, na.rm = TRUE))
  } else {
    0
  }

  top_score <- if (n_sources > 0) {
    round(max(df$match_score, na.rm = TRUE))
  } else {
    0
  }

  open_count <- if (n_sources > 0) {
    sum(
      df$access_burden_for_filter == "Low" |
        stringr::str_detect(
          tolower(df$access_level_standardized),
          "open|public"
        ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    0
  }

  top_source <- if (n_sources > 0) {
    as_text(df$data_source[1])
  } else {
    "None"
  }

  tile <- function(value, label, detail = NULL) {

    tags$div(
      style = paste0(
        "background:#FFFFFF;",
        "border:1px solid #E5E7EB;",
        "border-radius:14px;",
        "padding:18px 20px;"
      ),

      tags$div(
        style = paste0(
          "font-size:26px;",
          "font-weight:800;",
          "line-height:1;",
          "color:#73000A;"
        ),
        value
      ),

      tags$div(
        style = paste0(
          "margin-top:7px;",
          "font-size:12px;",
          "font-weight:700;",
          "text-transform:uppercase;",
          "letter-spacing:0.04em;",
          "color:#4B5563;"
        ),
        label
      ),

      if (!is.null(detail) && nzchar(detail)) {
        tags$div(
          style = paste0(
            "margin-top:5px;",
            "font-size:12px;",
            "line-height:1.4;",
            "color:#6B7280;"
          ),
          detail
        )
      }
    )
  }

  tags$div(

    style = paste0(
      "display:grid;",
      "grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));",
      "gap:14px;"
    ),

    tile(
      n_sources,
      "Matching Sources",
      "Current filtered results"
    ),

    tile(
      paste0(avg_score, "%"),
      "Average Match",
      "Across current results"
    ),

    tile(
      paste0(top_score, "%"),
      "Highest Match",
      top_source
    ),

    tile(
      open_count,
      "Open / Public",
      "Low-burden or public access"
    )
  )
})

output$score_plot <- renderPlot({

  df <- scored_results() |>
    dplyr::slice_head(n = min(10, input$top_n))

  validate(
    need(
      nrow(df) > 0,
      "No results to plot."
    )
  )

  ggplot(
    df,
    aes(
      x = reorder(data_source, match_score),
      y = match_score
    )
  ) +

    geom_col(
      width = 0.65
    ) +

    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = paste0(round(match_score), "%")
      ),
      hjust = -0.15,
      size = 3.5
    ) +

    coord_flip(
      clip = "off"
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 105),
      breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100)
    ) +

    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +

    theme_minimal(
      base_size = 12
    ) +

    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 25, 5, 5)
    )
})


output$category_plot <- renderPlot({

  df <- scored_results() |>

    tidyr::separate_rows(
      category_for_filter,
      sep = ";"
    ) |>

    dplyr::mutate(
      category_for_filter =
        stringr::str_squish(category_for_filter)
    ) |>

    dplyr::filter(
      nchar(category_for_filter) > 0
    ) |>

    dplyr::count(
      category_for_filter,
      sort = TRUE
    ) |>

    dplyr::slice_head(n = 8)

  validate(
    need(
      nrow(df) > 0,
      "No categories to plot."
    )
  )

  ggplot(
    df,
    aes(
      x = reorder(category_for_filter, n),
      y = n
    )
  ) +

    geom_col(
      width = 0.65
    ) +

    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = n
      ),
      hjust = -0.15,
      size = 3.5
    ) +

    coord_flip(
      clip = "off"
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))
    ) +

    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +

    theme_minimal(
      base_size = 12
    ) +

    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 25, 5, 5)
    )
})

data_fit_summary <- reactive({

  df <- scored_results() |>
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 6)

  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Primary source
  # -------------------------------------------------

  top <- df[1, ]

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Strongest sources
  # -------------------------------------------------

  strong_sources <- df |>
    dplyr::filter(match_score >= 70) |>
    dplyr::pull(data_source)

  if (length(strong_sources) == 0) {
    strong_sources <- head(df$data_source, min(3, nrow(df)))
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Why these sources matched
  # -------------------------------------------------

  matched_terms <- unique(
    unlist(
      stringr::str_split(
        as_text(df$matched_terms),
        ";"
      )
    )
  )

  matched_terms <- stringr::str_squish(matched_terms)
  matched_terms <- matched_terms[nchar(matched_terms) > 0]
  matched_terms <- head(unique(matched_terms), 8)

  why_text <- if (length(matched_terms) > 0) {
    paste(
      "The strongest matches align with the search through",
      paste(matched_terms, collapse = ", "),
      "."
    )
  } else {
    paste(
      "The strongest matches were ranked based on the available",
      "keyword, concept, category, data-type, geography, access,",
      "and linkage signals."
    )
  }
  
  # -------------------------------------------------
# Search coverage
# -------------------------------------------------

matched_top_terms <- as_text(top$matched_original_terms)
missing_top_terms <- as_text(top$missing_original_terms)

coverage_text <- if (
  nzchar(missing_top_terms) &&
  nzchar(matched_top_terms)
) {

  paste0(
    "The leading source matches ",
    top$original_terms_matched_n,
    " of ",
    top$original_terms_total_n,
    " original search concepts (",
    round(top$original_term_coverage),
    "% coverage). ",
    "Matched: ",
    matched_top_terms,
    ". ",
    "Not found: ",
    missing_top_terms,
    "."
  )

} else if (nzchar(missing_top_terms)) {

  paste0(
    "The leading source matches ",
    top$original_terms_matched_n,
    " of ",
    top$original_terms_total_n,
    " original search concepts (",
    round(top$original_term_coverage),
    "% coverage). ",
    "Not found: ",
    missing_top_terms,
    "."
  )

} else {

  paste0(
    "The leading source matches all ",
    top$original_terms_total_n,
    " original search concepts."
  )
}

  # Add the strongest source's specific matching rationale
  top_why <- as_text(top$why_matched)

  if (nzchar(top_why)) {
    why_text <- paste(
      why_text,
      "For the leading source, the ranking rationale was:",
      top_why
    )
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Tradeoffs
  # -------------------------------------------------

  access_values <- unique(
    as_text(df$access_level_standardized)
  )

  burden_values <- unique(
    as_text(df$access_burden_for_filter)
  )

  tradeoff_parts <- character()

  if (length(access_values) > 0) {

    tradeoff_parts <- c(
      tradeoff_parts,
      paste0(
        "Access varies across the leading sources: ",
        paste(access_values, collapse = "; "),
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  if (length(burden_values) > 0) {

    tradeoff_parts <- c(
      tradeoff_parts,
      paste0(
        "The access burden ranges from ",
        paste(burden_values, collapse = ", "),
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  # Compare linkage potential
  linkage_values <- unique(
    tolower(as_text(df$linkage_potential))
  )

  linkage_values <- linkage_values[nzchar(linkage_values)]

  if (length(linkage_values) > 0) {

    tradeoff_parts <- c(
      tradeoff_parts,
      paste0(
        "Linkage potential across the leading sources includes ",
        paste(unique(linkage_values), collapse = ", "),
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  # Geographic tradeoff
  geography_values <- unique(
    as_text(df$geography_coverage)
  )

  geography_values <- geography_values[nzchar(geography_values)]

  if (length(geography_values) > 0) {

    tradeoff_parts <- c(
      tradeoff_parts,
      paste0(
        "Geographic coverage differs across sources, including ",
        paste(head(geography_values, 4), collapse = "; "),
        "."
      )
    )
  }

  tradeoff_text <- if (length(tradeoff_parts) > 0) {
    paste(tradeoff_parts, collapse = " ")
  } else {
    "Tradeoffs could not be fully characterized from the current source fields."
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Strongest source recommendation
  # -------------------------------------------------

  strongest_text <- if (length(strong_sources) == 1) {

    paste0(
      strong_sources[1],
      " appears to be the strongest current match."
    )

  } else {

    paste0(
      paste(strong_sources, collapse = ", "),
      " look like the strongest current matches."
    )
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Practical recommendation
  # -------------------------------------------------

  recommendation_text <- paste0(
    "Start with ",
    top$data_source,
    " as the primary source because it has the highest current ",
    "match score (",
    round(top$match_score),
    "%). "
  )

  if (length(strong_sources) > 1) {

    companion_sources <- strong_sources[
      strong_sources != top$data_source
    ]

    if (length(companion_sources) > 0) {

      recommendation_text <- paste0(
        recommendation_text,
        paste(
          "Use",
          paste(companion_sources, collapse = " and "),
          "as secondary or companion sources where they add complementary coverage."
        )
      )
    }
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Return structured narrative
  # -------------------------------------------------

  list(
    top_source = as_text(top$data_source),
    top_score = round(top$match_score),
    coverage = coverage_text,
    why = why_text,
    tradeoffs = tradeoff_text,
    strongest = strongest_text,
    recommendation = recommendation_text
  )
})

output$fit_summary <- renderUI({

  summary <- data_fit_summary()

  if (is.null(summary)) {

    return(
      tags$div(

        style = paste0(
          "padding:40px;",
          "text-align:center;",
          "background:#FFFFFF;",
          "border:1px solid #E5E7EB;",
          "border-radius:14px;"
        ),

        tags$h3(
          style = "margin:0 0 8px;color:#1F2937;",
          "No recommendation available"
        ),

        tags$p(
          style = "margin:0;color:#6B7280;",
          "Run a search with matching sources to generate a data fit recommendation."
        )
      )
    )
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Narrative section helper
  # -------------------------------------------------

  narrative_section <- function(number, title, text) {

    tags$div(

      style = paste0(
        "padding:18px 20px;",
        "background:#FFFFFF;",
        "border:1px solid #E5E7EB;",
        "border-radius:12px;"
      ),

      tags$div(

        style = paste0(
          "display:flex;",
          "align-items:center;",
          "gap:10px;",
          "margin-bottom:8px;"
        ),

        tags$span(
          style = paste0(
            "display:inline-flex;",
            "align-items:center;",
            "justify-content:center;",
            "width:28px;",
            "height:28px;",
            "border-radius:50%;",
            "background:#F8F1F2;",
            "color:#73000A;",
            "font-size:12px;",
            "font-weight:800;"
          ),
          number
        ),

        tags$h4(
          style = paste0(
            "margin:0;",
            "font-size:15px;",
            "font-weight:800;",
            "color:#1F2937;"
          ),
          title
        )
      ),

      tags$p(
        style = paste0(
          "margin:0;",
          "font-size:14px;",
          "line-height:1.65;",
          "color:#4B5563;"
        ),
        text
      )
    )
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Strongest source badges
  # -------------------------------------------------

  strongest_badges <- summary$strongest

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Final recommendation block
  # -------------------------------------------------

  tags$div(

    # Main recommendation
    tags$div(

      style = paste0(
        "background:#73000A;",
        "color:#FFFFFF;",
        "border-radius:16px;",
        "padding:24px 26px;",
        "margin-bottom:18px;"
      ),

      tags$div(
        style = paste0(
          "font-size:11px;",
          "font-weight:800;",
          "letter-spacing:0.08em;",
          "text-transform:uppercase;",
          "opacity:0.85;",
          "margin-bottom:6px;"
        ),
        "Data Fit Recommendation"
      ),

      tags$h3(
        style = paste0(
          "margin:0 0 8px;",
          "font-size:24px;",
          "font-weight:800;",
          "line-height:1.25;"
        ),
        summary$top_source
      ),

      tags$p(
        style = paste0(
          "margin:0 0 12px;",
          "font-size:15px;",
          "line-height:1.6;",
          "opacity:0.92;"
        ),
        summary$recommendation
      ),

      tags$span(
        style = paste0(
          "display:inline-flex;",
          "padding:6px 10px;",
          "border-radius:999px;",
          "background:rgba(255,255,255,0.14);",
          "font-size:12px;",
          "font-weight:700;"
        ),
        paste0(summary$top_score, "% match")
      )
    ),

# Narrative sections
tags$div(
  style = paste0(
    "display:flex;",
    "flex-direction:column;",
    "gap:14px;"
  ),

  narrative_section(
    "1",
    "Search Coverage",
    summary$coverage
  ),

  narrative_section(
    "2",
    "Why these sources matched",
    summary$why
  ),

  narrative_section(
    "3",
    "Tradeoffs to consider",
    summary$tradeoffs
  ),

  narrative_section(
    "4",
    "Strongest sources",
    strongest_badges
  )
),

    # Caution
    tags$div(

      style = paste0(
        "margin-top:18px;",
        "padding:14px 16px;",
        "background:#F9FAFB;",
        "border:1px solid #EEF2F7;",
        "border-radius:10px;"
      ),

      tags$p(
        style = paste0(
          "margin:0;",
          "font-size:12px;",
          "line-height:1.5;",
          "color:#6B7280;"
        ),

        tags$b(
          style = "color:#4B5563;",
          "Note: "
        ),

        "This recommendation supports source triage and feasibility review. ",
        "Confirm the outcome, exposure, population, geography, years, ",
        "analytic unit, and source-specific access requirements before ",
        "moving into formal data requests or analysis planning."
      )
    )
  )
})

output$download_results <- downloadHandler(

  filename = function() {
    paste0(
      "RDCD_Data_Source_Discovery_Report_",
      Sys.Date(),
      ".docx"
    )
  },

  contentType =
    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",

  content = function(file) {

    # ============================================================
    # GET RESULTS
    # ============================================================

    df <- scored_results()

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      stop(
        "No search results are available. Please run a search first."
      )
    }

    df <- df |>
      dplyr::slice_head(
        n = input$top_n
      )

    # ============================================================
    # START WORD DOCUMENT
    # ============================================================

    doc <- officer::read_docx()

    # ============================================================
    # TITLE
    # ============================================================

    title_fp <- officer::fpar(
      officer::ftext(
        "RDCD Public Data Discovery Navigator",
        prop = officer::fp_text(
          bold = TRUE,
          color = "#73000A",
          font.size = 22
        )
      ),
      fp_p = officer::fp_par(
        padding.bottom = 4
      )
    )

    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      title_fp
    )

    subtitle_fp <- officer::fpar(
      officer::ftext(
        "Data Source Discovery Results",
        prop = officer::fp_text(
          color = "#6B7280",
          font.size = 12
        )
      ),
      fp_p = officer::fp_par(
        padding.bottom = 3
      )
    )

    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      subtitle_fp
    )

    date_fp <- officer::fpar(
      officer::ftext(
        paste0(
          "Generated ",
          Sys.Date()
        ),
        prop = officer::fp_text(
          color = "#9CA3AF",
          font.size = 9
        )
      ),
      fp_p = officer::fp_par(
        padding.bottom = 12
      )
    )

    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      date_fp
    )

    # ============================================================
    # SEARCH CONTEXT
    # ============================================================

    heading_fp <- officer::fpar(
      officer::ftext(
        "Search Context",
        prop = officer::fp_text(
          bold = TRUE,
          color = "#73000A",
          font.size = 15
        )
      ),
      fp_p = officer::fp_par(
        padding.top = 8,
        padding.bottom = 6
      )
    )

    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      heading_fp
    )

    question_text <- as_text(
      input$question
    )

    if (!nzchar(question_text)) {
      question_text <- "No research question entered."
    }

    keywords_text <- paste(
      search_terms(),
      collapse = ", "
    )

    if (!nzchar(keywords_text)) {
      keywords_text <- "None entered."
    }

    # Research question
    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      officer::fpar(
        officer::ftext(
          "Research Question: ",
          prop = officer::fp_text(
            bold = TRUE,
            color = "#5B0008",
            font.size = 10
          )
        ),
        officer::ftext(
          question_text,
          prop = officer::fp_text(
            color = "#374151",
            font.size = 10
          )
        ),
        fp_p = officer::fp_par(
          padding.bottom = 4
        )
      )
    )

    # Keywords
    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      officer::fpar(
        officer::ftext(
          "Keywords: ",
          prop = officer::fp_text(
            bold = TRUE,
            color = "#5B0008",
            font.size = 10
          )
        ),
        officer::ftext(
          keywords_text,
          prop = officer::fp_text(
            color = "#374151",
            font.size = 10
          )
        ),
        fp_p = officer::fp_par(
          padding.bottom = 4
        )
      )
    )

    # Minimum match score
    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      officer::fpar(
        officer::ftext(
          "Minimum Match Score: ",
          prop = officer::fp_text(
            bold = TRUE,
            color = "#5B0008",
            font.size = 10
          )
        ),
        officer::ftext(
          paste0(
            input$min_score,
            "%"
          ),
          prop = officer::fp_text(
            color = "#374151",
            font.size = 10
          )
        ),
        fp_p = officer::fp_par(
          padding.bottom = 4
        )
      )
    )

    # Results included
    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      officer::fpar(
        officer::ftext(
          "Results Included: ",
          prop = officer::fp_text(
            bold = TRUE,
            color = "#5B0008",
            font.size = 10
          )
        ),
        officer::ftext(
          as.character(nrow(df)),
          prop = officer::fp_text(
            bold = TRUE,
            color = "#73000A",
            font.size = 10
          )
        ),
        fp_p = officer::fp_par(
          padding.bottom = 10
        )
      )
    )

    # ============================================================
    # RESULTS AT A GLANCE
    # ============================================================

    heading_fp <- officer::fpar(
      officer::ftext(
        "Results at a Glance",
        prop = officer::fp_text(
          bold = TRUE,
          color = "#73000A",
          font.size = 15
        )
      ),
      fp_p = officer::fp_par(
        padding.top = 8,
        padding.bottom = 6
      )
    )

    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      heading_fp
    )

    total_matches <- nrow(df)

    average_score <- if (total_matches > 0) {
      mean(
        as.numeric(df$match_score),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      0
    }

    highest_score <- if (total_matches > 0) {
      max(
        as.numeric(df$match_score),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      0
    }

    open_public_count <- if (total_matches > 0) {
      sum(
        df$access_burden_for_filter == "Low" |
          stringr::str_detect(
            tolower(
              df$access_level_standardized
            ),
            "open|public"
          ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      0
    }

    metrics_fp <- officer::fpar(
      officer::ftext(
        paste0(
          total_matches,
          " matching sources"
        ),
        prop = officer::fp_text(
          bold = TRUE,
          color = "#73000A",
          font.size = 11
        )
      ),
      officer::ftext(
        "    |    ",
        prop = officer::fp_text(
          color = "#9CA3AF",
          font.size = 10
        )
      ),
      officer::ftext(
        paste0(
          "Average ",
          round(average_score),
          "%"
        ),
        prop = officer::fp_text(
          bold = TRUE,
          color = "#374151",
          font.size = 10
        )
      ),
      officer::ftext(
        "    |    ",
        prop = officer::fp_text(
          color = "#9CA3AF",
          font.size = 10
        )
      ),
      officer::ftext(
        paste0(
          "Highest ",
          round(highest_score),
          "%"
        ),
        prop = officer::fp_text(
          bold = TRUE,
          color = "#166534",
          font.size = 10
        )
      ),
      officer::ftext(
        "    |    ",
        prop = officer::fp_text(
          color = "#9CA3AF",
          font.size = 10
        )
      ),
      officer::ftext(
        paste0(
          open_public_count,
          " open/public"
        ),
        prop = officer::fp_text(
          bold = TRUE,
          color = "#374151",
          font.size = 10
        )
      ),
      fp_p = officer::fp_par(
        padding.bottom = 12
      )
    )

    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      metrics_fp
    )

    # ============================================================
    # TOP MATCHING SOURCES
    # ============================================================

    heading_fp <- officer::fpar(
      officer::ftext(
        "Top Matching Sources",
        prop = officer::fp_text(
          bold = TRUE,
          color = "#73000A",
          font.size = 15
        )
      ),
      fp_p = officer::fp_par(
        padding.top = 8,
        padding.bottom = 8
      )
    )

    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      heading_fp
    )

    # ============================================================
    # SOURCE SECTIONS
    # ============================================================

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {

      row <- df[i, ]

      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # Source title
      # ----------------------------------------------------------

      doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
        doc,
        officer::fpar(
          officer::ftext(
            paste0(
              i,
              ". ",
              as_text(row$data_source)
            ),
            prop = officer::fp_text(
              bold = TRUE,
              color = "#1F2937",
              font.size = 14
            )
          ),
          fp_p = officer::fp_par(
            padding.top = 10,
            padding.bottom = 4,
            keep_with_next = TRUE
          )
        )
      )

      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # Match / access
      # ----------------------------------------------------------

      score_text <- if (
        is.na(row$match_score)
      ) {
        "N/A"
      } else {
        paste0(
          round(
            as.numeric(row$match_score)
          ),
          "% match"
        )
      }

      access_text <- make_report_access_label(
        row$access_level_standardized
      )

      doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
        doc,
        officer::fpar(
          officer::ftext(
            score_text,
            prop = officer::fp_text(
              bold = TRUE,
              color = "#166534",
              font.size = 10
            )
          ),
          officer::ftext(
            "    |    ",
            prop = officer::fp_text(
              color = "#9CA3AF",
              font.size = 10
            )
          ),
          officer::ftext(
            access_text,
            prop = officer::fp_text(
              bold = TRUE,
              color = "#73000A",
              font.size = 10
            )
          ),
          fp_p = officer::fp_par(
            padding.bottom = 7
          )
        )
      )

      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # Summary heading
      # ----------------------------------------------------------

      doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
        doc,
        officer::fpar(
          officer::ftext(
            "Summary",
            prop = officer::fp_text(
              bold = TRUE,
              color = "#5B0008",
              font.size = 10
            )
          ),
          fp_p = officer::fp_par(
            padding.top = 5,
            padding.bottom = 2
          )
        )
      )

      # Summary text
      summary_text <- as_text(
        row$main_data_type_use
      )

      if (!nzchar(summary_text)) {
        summary_text <- as_text(
          row$suggested_use_cases
        )
      }

      if (!nzchar(summary_text)) {
        summary_text <- "No summary is available for this source."
      }

      doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
        doc,
        officer::fpar(
          officer::ftext(
            summary_text,
            prop = officer::fp_text(
              color = "#374151",
              font.size = 10
            )
          ),
          fp_p = officer::fp_par(
            padding.bottom = 5
          )
        )
      )

      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # Key Details heading
      # ----------------------------------------------------------

      doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
        doc,
        officer::fpar(
          officer::ftext(
            "Key Details",
            prop = officer::fp_text(
              bold = TRUE,
              color = "#5B0008",
              font.size = 10
            )
          ),
          fp_p = officer::fp_par(
            padding.top = 5,
            padding.bottom = 3
          )
        )
      )

      key_details <- list(
        "Category" =
          report_value(
            row$category_for_filter
          ),

        "Data Type" =
          report_value(
            row$data_type_for_filter
          ),

        "Population" =
          report_value(
            row$population
          ),

        "Geography" =
          report_value(
            row$geography_coverage
          ),

        "Unit of Analysis" =
          report_value(
            row$unit_of_analysis
          ),

        "Years Available" =
          report_value(
            row$years_available
          ),

        "Access Burden" =
          report_value(
            row$access_burden_for_filter
          ),

        "Linkage Potential" =
          report_value(
            row$linkage_potential
          ),

        "South Carolina Relevance" =
          report_value(
            row$south_carolina_relevance
          )
      )

      for (detail_name in names(key_details)) {

        doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
          doc,
          officer::fpar(
            officer::ftext(
              paste0(
                detail_name,
                ": "
              ),
              prop = officer::fp_text(
                bold = TRUE,
                color = "#5B0008",
                font.size = 9.5
              )
            ),
            officer::ftext(
              key_details[[detail_name]],
              prop = officer::fp_text(
                color = "#374151",
                font.size = 9.5
              )
            ),
            fp_p = officer::fp_par(
              padding.bottom = 2
            )
          )
        )
      }

      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # Why It Matched
      # ----------------------------------------------------------

      doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
        doc,
        officer::fpar(
          officer::ftext(
            "Why It Matched",
            prop = officer::fp_text(
              bold = TRUE,
              color = "#5B0008",
              font.size = 10
            )
          ),
          fp_p = officer::fp_par(
            padding.top = 6,
            padding.bottom = 2
          )
        )
      )

      doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
        doc,
        officer::fpar(
          officer::ftext(
            report_value(
              row$why_matched
            ),
            prop = officer::fp_text(
              color = "#374151",
              font.size = 10
            )
          ),
          fp_p = officer::fp_par(
            padding.bottom = 5
          )
        )
      )

      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # Limitations
      # ----------------------------------------------------------

      limitations <- as_text(
        row$limitations_cautions
      )

      if (nzchar(limitations)) {

        doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
          doc,
          officer::fpar(
            officer::ftext(
              "Limitations",
              prop = officer::fp_text(
                bold = TRUE,
                color = "#5B0008",
                font.size = 10
              )
            ),
            fp_p = officer::fp_par(
              padding.top = 6,
              padding.bottom = 2
            )
          )
        )

        doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
          doc,
          officer::fpar(
            officer::ftext(
              limitations,
              prop = officer::fp_text(
                color = "#374151",
                font.size = 10
              )
            ),
            fp_p = officer::fp_par(
              padding.bottom = 5
            )
          )
        )
      }

          # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # Official Source
      # ----------------------------------------------------------

      official_url <- as_text(
        row$official_url
      )

      if (nzchar(official_url)) {

        doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
          doc,
          officer::fpar(
            officer::ftext(
              "Official Source",
              prop = officer::fp_text(
                bold = TRUE,
                color = "#5B0008",
                font.size = 10
              )
            ),
            fp_p = officer::fp_par(
              padding.top = 6,
              padding.bottom = 2
            )
          )
        )

        doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
          doc,
          officer::fpar(
            officer::ftext(
              official_url,
              prop = officer::fp_text(
                color = "#73000A",
                underline = TRUE,
                font.size = 9.5
              )
            ),
            fp_p = officer::fp_par(
              padding.bottom = 8
            )
          )
        )
      }

      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # Separator
      # ----------------------------------------------------------

      separator <- officer::fpar(
        officer::ftext(
          "----------------------------------------",
          prop = officer::fp_text(
            color = "#D1D5DB",
            font.size = 8
          )
        ),
        fp_p = officer::fp_par(
          padding.top = 4,
          padding.bottom = 4
        )
      )

      doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
        doc,
        separator
      )

      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # New page after every 3 sources
      # ----------------------------------------------------------

      if (
        i < nrow(df) &&
        i %% 3 == 0
      ) {

        doc <- officer::body_add_break(
          doc,
          pos = "after"
        )
      }
    }

    # ============================================================
    # RDCD NOTE
    # ============================================================

    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      officer::fpar(
        officer::ftext(
          "RDCD Note",
          prop = officer::fp_text(
            bold = TRUE,
            color = "#73000A",
            font.size = 15
          )
        ),
        fp_p = officer::fp_par(
          padding.top = 10,
          padding.bottom = 5
        )
      )
    )

    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      officer::fpar(
        officer::ftext(
          paste(
            "This report supports data-source triage and feasibility review.",
            "It does not replace IRB review, data-use agreements,",
            "data governance review, or source-specific access requirements."
          ),
          prop = officer::fp_text(
            color = "#374151",
            font.size = 10
          )
        )
      )
    )

    # ============================================================
    # WRITE DOCUMENT
    # ============================================================

    print(
      doc,
      target = file
    )

    # ============================================================
    # VERIFY DOCUMENT
    # ============================================================

    if (!file.exists(file)) {
      stop(
        "Word report was not created."
      )
    }

    if (
      is.na(file.info(file)$size) ||
      file.info(file)$size <= 0
    ) {
      stop(
        "Word report was created but is empty."
      )
    }
  }
)
    
output$download_html_report <- downloadHandler(

  filename = function() {
    paste0(
      "RDCD_Data_Source_Discovery_Report_",
      Sys.Date(),
      ".html"
    )
  },

  contentType = "text/html; charset=UTF-8",

  content = function(file) {

    df <- scored_results()

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      stop(
        "No search results are available. Please run a search first."
      )
    }

    df <- df |>
      dplyr::slice_head(
        n = input$top_n
      )

    keywords_text <- paste(
      search_terms()$original,
      collapse = ", "
    )

    report_html <- make_html_report(
      df = df,
      question = input$question,
      keywords = keywords_text,
      min_score = input$min_score,
      top_n = nrow(df)
    )

    writeLines(
      report_html,
      con = file,
      useBytes = TRUE
    )
  }
)

output$download_excel <- downloadHandler(

  filename = function() {
    paste0(
      "RDCD_Data_Source_Discovery_Report_",
      Sys.Date(),
      ".xlsx"
    )
  },

  contentType = paste0(
    "application/",
    "vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.",
    "spreadsheetml.sheet"
  ),

  content = function(file) {

    df <- scored_results()

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      stop(
        "No search results are available. Please run a search first."
      )
    }

    df <- df |>
      dplyr::slice_head(
        n = input$top_n
      ) |>
      dplyr::select(
        record_id,
        data_source,
        match_score,
        official_url,
        main_data_type_use,
        access_level_standardized,
        access_burden_for_filter,
        category_for_filter,
        data_type_for_filter,
        geography_coverage,
        geographic_unit,
        unit_of_analysis,
        population,
        years_available,
        linkage_potential,
        south_carolina_relevance,
        why_matched,
        limitations_cautions
      )

    openxlsx::write.xlsx(
      df,
      file = file,
      overwrite = TRUE
    )
  }
)

output$download_summary <- downloadHandler(

  filename = function() {
    paste0(
      "RDCD_Data_Fit_Summary_",
      Sys.Date(),
      ".docx"
    )
  },

  contentType =
    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",

  content = function(file) {

    # ============================================================
    # GET SUMMARY
    # ============================================================

    summary <- data_fit_summary()

    if (is.null(summary)) {
      stop(
        "No data fit recommendation is currently available. Please run a search first."
      )
    }

    # ============================================================
    # CREATE WORD DOCUMENT
    # ============================================================

    doc <- officer::read_docx()

    # ============================================================
    # TITLE
    # ============================================================

    title_fp <- officer::fpar(
      officer::ftext(
        "RDCD Data Fit Recommendation",
        prop = officer::fp_text(
          bold = TRUE,
          color = "#73000A",
          font.size = 22
        )
      ),
      fp_p = officer::fp_par(
        padding.bottom = 4
      )
    )

    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      title_fp
    )

    subtitle_fp <- officer::fpar(
      officer::ftext(
        "Data Source Discovery Summary",
        prop = officer::fp_text(
          color = "#6B7280",
          font.size = 12
        )
      ),
      fp_p = officer::fp_par(
        padding.bottom = 3
      )
    )

    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      subtitle_fp
    )

    date_fp <- officer::fpar(
      officer::ftext(
        paste0(
          "Generated ",
          Sys.Date()
        ),
        prop = officer::fp_text(
          color = "#9CA3AF",
          font.size = 9
        )
      ),
      fp_p = officer::fp_par(
        padding.bottom = 12
      )
    )

    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      date_fp
    )

    # ============================================================
    # PRIMARY RECOMMENDATION
    # ============================================================

    heading_fp <- officer::fpar(
      officer::ftext(
        "Primary Recommendation",
        prop = officer::fp_text(
          bold = TRUE,
          color = "#73000A",
          font.size = 15
        )
      ),
      fp_p = officer::fp_par(
        padding.top = 8,
        padding.bottom = 6
      )
    )

    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      heading_fp
    )

    # Source name
    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      officer::fpar(
        officer::ftext(
          summary$top_source,
          prop = officer::fp_text(
            bold = TRUE,
            color = "#1F2937",
            font.size = 17
          )
        ),
        fp_p = officer::fp_par(
          padding.bottom = 4,
          keep_with_next = TRUE
        )
      )
    )

    # Match score
    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      officer::fpar(
        officer::ftext(
          paste0(
            summary$top_score,
            "% match"
          ),
          prop = officer::fp_text(
            bold = TRUE,
            color = "#166534",
            font.size = 11
          )
        ),
        fp_p = officer::fp_par(
          padding.bottom = 8
        )
      )
    )

    # Recommendation text
    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      officer::fpar(
        officer::ftext(
          summary$recommendation,
          prop = officer::fp_text(
            color = "#374151",
            font.size = 10.5
          )
        ),
        fp_p = officer::fp_par(
          padding.bottom = 12
        )
      )
    )

    # ============================================================
    # WHY THESE SOURCES MATCHED
    # ============================================================

    heading_fp <- officer::fpar(
      officer::ftext(
        "Why These Sources Matched",
        prop = officer::fp_text(
          bold = TRUE,
          color = "#73000A",
          font.size = 14
        )
      ),
      fp_p = officer::fp_par(
        padding.top = 8,
        padding.bottom = 5
      )
    )

    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      heading_fp
    )

    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      officer::fpar(
        officer::ftext(
          summary$why,
          prop = officer::fp_text(
            color = "#374151",
            font.size = 10
          )
        ),
        fp_p = officer::fp_par(
          padding.bottom = 10
        )
      )
    )

    # ============================================================
    # TRADEOFFS
    # ============================================================

    heading_fp <- officer::fpar(
      officer::ftext(
        "Tradeoffs to Consider",
        prop = officer::fp_text(
          bold = TRUE,
          color = "#73000A",
          font.size = 14
        )
      ),
      fp_p = officer::fp_par(
        padding.top = 8,
        padding.bottom = 5
      )
    )

    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      heading_fp
    )

    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      officer::fpar(
        officer::ftext(
          summary$tradeoffs,
          prop = officer::fp_text(
            color = "#374151",
            font.size = 10
          )
        ),
        fp_p = officer::fp_par(
          padding.bottom = 10
        )
      )
    )

    # ============================================================
    # STRONGEST SOURCES
    # ============================================================

    heading_fp <- officer::fpar(
      officer::ftext(
        "Strongest Sources",
        prop = officer::fp_text(
          bold = TRUE,
          color = "#73000A",
          font.size = 14
        )
      ),
      fp_p = officer::fp_par(
        padding.top = 8,
        padding.bottom = 5
      )
    )

    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      heading_fp
    )

    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      officer::fpar(
        officer::ftext(
          summary$strongest,
          prop = officer::fp_text(
            color = "#374151",
            font.size = 10
          )
        ),
        fp_p = officer::fp_par(
          padding.bottom = 10
        )
      )
    )

    # ============================================================
    # CAUTION
    # ============================================================

    heading_fp <- officer::fpar(
      officer::ftext(
        "Caution",
        prop = officer::fp_text(
          bold = TRUE,
          color = "#73000A",
          font.size = 14
        )
      ),
      fp_p = officer::fp_par(
        padding.top = 8,
        padding.bottom = 5
      )
    )

    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      heading_fp
    )

    doc <- officer::body_add_fpar(
      doc,
      officer::fpar(
        officer::ftext(
          paste(
            "This tool supports source triage and feasibility review.",
            "Confirm source-specific access, governance, linkage,",
            "and analytic requirements before formal data requests."
          ),
          prop = officer::fp_text(
            color = "#374151",
            font.size = 10
          )
        ),
        fp_p = officer::fp_par(
          padding.bottom = 10
        )
      )
    )

    # ============================================================
    # WRITE DOCUMENT
    # ============================================================

    print(
      doc,
      target = file
    )

    # ============================================================
    # VERIFY
    # ============================================================

    if (!file.exists(file)) {
      stop(
        "The Data Fit Summary Word document was not created."
      )
    }

    if (
      is.na(file.info(file)$size) ||
      file.info(file)$size <= 0
    ) {
      stop(
        "The Data Fit Summary Word document was created but is empty."
      )
    }
  }
)
